1120: Lehu bikdushsha. bar lehane, ad deityayshshevan begufa innun ruchin, batar telatin utelat yomin, ashgachat alayyhu kol yoma, deha ruchin mitkashsheran begufa kishar bene alma, kema dehi la sharya ella baatar shelim, kach kol ovadoy kehay gavvna, ad deishtelimu. bechol kodesh lo tiga, leashgecha alayyhu.

Veim nekeva teled. kema deokimna, deshalta setar semala yatir veitkafya yemina, veal da kolla al chad teren, rechika nukeba, middechura, leitkashshera rucha begufa, deha semala la ityayshva hachi kimina, veishtechachat betukefa yatir.

Deha behahu zimna demitkanshe amma kaddisha leabera hahu arla mikkamme berit, kudesha berich hu kanish kol pamalya dileh, veitgele vadday leabera lehahu arla leella, mikkamme berit kayyayma kaddisha. deha kol ovadin deyisrael avdin letatta, mitare ovada leella. uvehahu zimna itdachyay hahu arla, mikkol amma kaddisha leella. ulehahu arla metakkene mana chada beafra, leashraa hahu arla begavih. beraza dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 65:25) venachash afar lachmo. (Bereshit 3:14) veafar tochal kol yeme chayyeycha.

Mikkan, (tikun sefer acher) dela itztzetrich leanhaga kelana behahu atar, af al gav dimavre leh mikkamme hay berit, veducheteh, kad mitabbera mehay berit, afra ihu, (sefer acher deha) dehare batar dehahu nachash itabbar mikkamme adam, kudesha berich hu shavvi leh madoreh beafar, dichtiv veafar tochal kol yeme chayyeycha. vechevan dekudesha berich hu kad abar leh mikkamme adam shavvi madoreh beafra veatkin leh, kach behahu gavvna mammash, anan tzerichin kad meabberin laarla, leittakna leh afra, lemehevi beh madoreh.

Kol bar nash itztzetrich lekarva hahu bera karbena lekudesha berich hu, bechedva, biru delibba, lemeal leh techot gadpoy dishchinta, veitchashshav kame kudesha berich hu deihu karbena, shelim leitkabbela beraava.

Vekarbena da, kegavvna dekarbena divira, da lach yomin, veda lach yomin, dichtiv, umiyyom hashshemini vahala yiratztze, bemay yiratztze. bemebar aleh chad shabbeta, kevan deabar aleh chad shabbeta, keden yiratztze da lekarbena, veda lekarbena. amay. begin deitdevak veizdeman legabbe hahu shabbat, raza divrit kaddisha, veal da kolla beraza illaa ihu. (ad kan raya mehemana)

(Vayikra 12:2) ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach, (Shmuel 1 2:2) en kadosh kaAdonai ki en biltecha veen tzur kelohenu, hay kera kashya, en kadosh kaAdonai, mashma deikka kadosh ochora, begin dichtiv kaAdonai, veen tzur kelohenu, mashma deikka tzur ochora.

Ella vadday, en kadosh kaAdonai, dechamma kaddishin ninhu, kadishin leella, dichtiv, (Daniel 4:14) umemar kadishin sheelta. yisrael kaddishin ninhu, dichtiv, (Vayikra 19) kedoshim tihyu. vechullehu kaddishin, velav kaddishin kaAdonai. umay tama. begin dichtiv, ki en biltecha. may, ki en biltecha, ella kedushsha dekudesha berich hu bilti kedushsha dilhon, dehu la itzterich likdushsha dilhon. aval innun, lav innun kaddishin biltecha, veda hu, ki en biltecha, en kedushsha dilhon, biltecha.

Veen tzur kelohenu. kema deukemuha, dekudesha berich hu tzar tzura bego tzura, vetakin leh, venafach rucha dechayye, veappik leh laavira dealma, davar acher, veen tzur kelohenu. it tzur, deikre tzur, (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzur chutztzavtem. (Shemot 17:6) vehikkita vatztzur. hinni omed lefanecha sham al hatztzur bechorev. vechullehu ikrun tzur, veen tzur bechullehu kelohenu, dileh shuletanu umalchuta al kolla.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi acha havo yatve lelya chad kammeh deribbi abba. kamu befalgut lelya lemile beorayyta. ad denafku levar, chamu chad kochava dehava batash 3 zimne bechochava ochora vesatim nehoreh. adhachi shamu tere kale bitre sitre, kala chad listar tzafon leella, vekala
1121: Chad letatta. vehahu kala achriz veamar, ulu veitkenishu leatrayychu, hasheta istamruta denukeba peticha, kudesha berich hu al letayyla beginta, leishtashea betzadikayyay di beginta, avar hahu kala veshachich.

Ahadru ribbi acha veribbi chiyay, amru, ha vaday iddan reuta, deitaruta dekneset yisrael (eden) hu leitchabbera bemalka kaddisha, amar ribbi acha, vaday, la (itchabberat) angidat lah keneset yisrael bekudesha berich hu ella miggo shirata, miggo shevacha dilah legabbeh. ad deate tzafra, veoshit lah malka chuta dechesed, veraza demilla kema deamrinan, (Ester Adonai:2) vayyoshet hammelech leester et sharvit hazzahav asher beyado vegomer. vela tema delah bilchodaha oshit lah malka da, ella lah, ulechol innun demitchabberan ba. ta venitchabber kachada. yatvu.

Patach ribbi acha veamar, (Bereshit 2:18) vayyomer Adonai elohim lo tov heyot haadam levaddo vegomer. amay patach kera hachi, ella ha ittemar, deal da la ketiv, ki tov bashsheni, begin dezammin adam leitparsha, uchetiv, lo tov heyot haadam levaddo.

Vechi levaddo hava, veha ketiv, (Bereshit Adonai:2) zachar unekeva beraam. vetanenan adam du partzufin itbere, veat amrat, lo tov heyot haadam levaddo. ella dela ishtedal benukeveh, vela havat leh, semech lokovleh, begin dehavat besitroy, vahavu kachada meachora, ucheden hava haadam levaddo.

Eese lo ezer kenegdo. mahu kenegdo, lokovel anpoy, leitdabbeka da beda anpin beanpin, ma avad kudesha berich hu, nasar leh venatil nukeba minneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:21) vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav. mahu achat. da nukeba dileh. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati. vayvieha el haadam, atkin lah kechalla veayyte lah lemehevi lokovel anpoy nehirin anpin beanpin. uveod dehava mitdabbeka nukeba besitroy, hava haadam levaddo. levatar, seliku teren, vekamu sheva kachada.

Ta chaze, beshaata deitkenash (sefer acher deittatkenat) legabbe adam, kudesha berich hu berich lon, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:22) vayvarech otam elohim. kechazzan dimvarech lechalla besheva berachot. mikkan olifna, chatan vechalla, kevan deitbarchan besheva berachot itdabbekan kachada, kedugema dilella.

Veal da man deate leitchabbera beintu deochora, ha pagim ziuuga, (kivyachol avid 2 rashuyot leella) deha ziuuga dekneset yisrael, beh bekudesha berich hu bilchodoy, bezimna deihu berachame, uvezimna deihu bedina. ta chaze, man demitchabbar beintu deochora, keillu meshakker beh bekudesha berich hu ubbikkeneset yisrael, veal da kudesha berich hu la mechapper leh bitshuva, uteshuva talya ad deyistalak mealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 22:14) im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun. veematay, beshaata deal bitshuva lehahu alma, veit leh lekabbela onsha.

Ribbi elazar amar, man dimshakker bikkeneset yisrael, la yitkabbal bitshuva, ad deyitdan bedina degehinnam. kol shekken, man dimshakker bikkeneset yisrael ubbekudesha berich hu. vekol shekken i atrach leh lekudesha berich hu lemebad diyyukena demamzer beintu deochora, veachchish pumebi demalka.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo vegomer. aviv, da kudesha berich hu. immo, da keneset yisrael. may gozel. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 3:14) gezelat heani bevattechem. uman ihu, man dechamid itteta ochora delav ihi bat zugeh.

Tamman tanenan, kol hannehne min haolam hazze belo beracha, keillu gozel lekudesha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael, dichtiv gozel aviv veimmo vegomer. kol hannehene min haolam hazze, kelal da, ihu intu. man deitdabbak beintu lemehene minnah, veaf al gav, deihi penuya, veahane minnah bela beracha, keillu gozel kudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael. may tama, begin deziuuga dilhon, besheva berachot hu. uma al penuya kach, man deyitdebak beintu deochora, dekaim kegavvna dilella, beziuuga dez berachot, al achat kama vechamma.

(Mishlei 28:24) chaver hu leish mashchit, da yaravam, kema deukemuha, veomer en pasha deamar ha penuya hi, amay asur. begin da gozel aviv veimmo havi. velo od ella dechaver hu leish mashchit. man hu ish mashchit. defagim diyyukena vetikkuna dilella. kol shekken man dechamid leintu dechavreh leitdabbeka (sefer acher veitdabbak bah) bah,
1122: Defagim yattir. veal da itpegim hu lealmin. ish mashchit, defagim leella, ufagim letatta, ufagim lenafsheh, dichtiv mashchit, uchetiv, (Mishlei 6:32) mashchit nafsho hu yaasenna.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Bereshit 32:27) vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar vegomer. vayyomer shallecheni, vechi akud hava bideh deyaakov. ella zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu chas al yekara dilhon, vela shavik lon lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 55:23) lo yitten leolam mot latztzadik. veha ketiv, (Bereshit 32:26) vatteka kaf yerech yaakov.

Ella ledideh gava. veha ittemar, ketiv (Bereshit 32:22) vehu lan ballayla hahu bammachane. uchetiv vayyikkachem vayyaavirem et hannachal may hava dateh deyaakov, lemaabbera lehon benachala belelya. ella chama mekatrega azil ben mashshiryay dileh, amar yaakov abar legisa ochora denahara, dilma la yishtekach irbuveya.

May ka chama. chama shalhova deeshsha melahata, azla vetas ben mashiryayteh amar yaakov mutav lenatla mehacha, venahara pasik begavavn, vela yishtekach irbuveya. miyyad vayyikkachem vayyaavirem et hannachal. vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, mikkan olifna man deishtechach bilchodoy beveta belelya, o bimama bevayit meyachada, kol shekken belelya, may meyachada. meyachada mishshear betin. o man deazil bilchodoy belelya yachil leitzeka.

Ta chaze vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, keden vayyeavek ish immo vegomer. tanenan missitra dedina ka ate, veshuletaneh bistar lelya. may bistar lelya. leaala galuta (nusach acher begaluta) kevan desalik nehora, tashash cheleh, veitgabbar aleh cheleh deyaakov. (nusach acher hu) deha missitra delelya ka ate, uvizmena dehava lelya la hava yachil beh yaakov. kad salik nehora ittekaf chela deyaakov, veachid beh, veitgabbar aleh. chama leh yaakov deha shelicha hu.

Amar leh shevok li dela yachilna lach. may tama la yachil leh. begin dehava salik nehora, veittebar chela dideh, dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim. may vayyariu. deittebaru kol innun deatyayn missitra dedina. keden ittakkaf yaakov veachid beh.

Amar leh shallecheni ki ala hashshachar, mata zimna leshabbecha shevacha dekudesha berich hu, uleitkannesha. vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani, im tevarcheni mibbae leh, may im berachtani. ella amar leh yaakov, vadday abba berich li innun birchan devaa levarcha leesav, umistafena minach, al innun birchan, i odit alayyhu, (o) i lav, o tishtechach alay mekatrega beginehon.

Miyyad amar leh, vayyomer lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha. may kaamar leh, ella hachi kaamar leh, lav bechakkimu, velav beukeva (dilach), ravvchat leinnun birchan, la yeamer od shimcha yaakov, deha lav beukeva hava, ki im yisrael, yisrael vadday ode alach, uminneh nafku birchan, begin deant achid beh, veal da, ana vechol shear uchelusin, odena alayyhu.

Ki sarita im elohim veim anashim vattuchol, im elohim kol innun deatyayn missitra dedina kashya. veim anashim, da esav veuchelusin dileh. vattuchol, yachilat lehon, veinnun la yachlin lach. vela shavik leh yaakov, ad deode leh al innun birchan, hada hu dichtiv vayvarech oto sham.

Ta chaze, beshaata desalik nehora, itkafyayn kol innun mare dedinin, vela mishtakkeche, ukkeneset yisrael mishtae beh bekudesha berich hu. vehahi shaata iddan deraava hu lecholla, veoshit lah malka ulechol innun demishtakkeche immah, sharvita dechuta dechesed, leishtakkecha bishlimu bemalka kaddisha, veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, beshaata dekudesha berich hu ishtechach bah bikkeneset yisrael, beinnun zimnin deishtechach immah, vehi matarat reuta legabbeh bekadmita, umashchat leh legabbah, bisgiut chibbata vetiuveta, keden itmalleya missitra dimina, vechamma uchelusin mishtakkeche besitra dimina, bechullehu almin. vechad kudesha berich hu ittear chavivuta ureuta bekadmita, vehi
1123: Ittearat levatar, velav bezimna deihu ittear, keden kolla besitra denukeba ishtechach, usemala ittear, vechamma uchelusin kayyme umitare besitra dismala bechullehu almin. kehay gavvna ketiv, (nusach acher hada hu dichtiv) ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vegomer. may tama. tanenan, alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa ishtechach, veda kedugema deda.

Veal da, kudesha berich hu gazar dechar o nukeba, leishtakkecha reuta bealma. uvecholla bae bar nash leitdabbeka reuta leella legabbe kudesha berich hu, leishtakkecha raavavn bealma. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deinnun yadin leadbeka reutehon legabbe malka kaddisha, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

(Vayikra 13:2) adam ki yihye veor besaro seet o sappachat o vaheret vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:6) al tiruni sheani shecharchoret sheshshezafatni hashshamesh, hay kera ittemar, aval beshaata desihara itkasseya begaluta, hi amra, al tiruni. lav deihi pekidat dela lemechome lah, ella begin deihi chamat tiuveta deyisrael legabbah, lemecheme nehoraha, hi amrat al tiruni, la techlun lemecheme li. al tiruni vadday. may tama. begin sheani shecharchoret, begin daana bekadruta.
May shecharchoret, shechora mibbae leh. ella, teren kadrute, chad sheshshezafatni hashshamesh, deistallak minni shimsha, leanhara li, uleistakkela bi. vechad divne immi nicharu vi.

Sheshshezafatni, shezafatni mibbae leh. ella remaz hu deka ramiz, beshesh. dechad nahara shimsha beshesh nehorin nahir, vechad istallak, kol innun shit nehorin istelaku. bene immi, illen innun deatyayn missitra dedina kashya. nicharu vi, kema deat amer (Tehillim 69:4) nichar geroni, hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha Adonai:Adonai) al tzavvarenu nirdafnu dechad havo ayylin yisrael begaluta, havo azle yedayyhu mehaddekan laachora, verechayin al tzavarehon, vela yachilu leaftecha puma.

Samuni notera et hakkeramim, lemehach begaluta, lenatra lishar ammin beginehon deyisrael. karmi shelli lo natarti, deha la yachilna lenatra lehon kad bekadmita. bekadmita netirna karmi shelli, uminneh itnetaru shear karmin. hasheta netirna shear karmin begin karmi shelli delihevi natir benayyhu.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle beorcha, kad matu chad be chakal, chamu chad daftira dekitfa ben archa listar yemina. amar ribbi yose, atifa dekutera beayynin shechiach, let lan reshu lemechome bechedvavta, miyyoma deitchariv be makdesha.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 24:1) laAdonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshve vah, kevan deamar laAdonai haaretz umeloah, amay tevel veyoshve va, vechi tevel lav min ara hu. ella hachi kaamar, laAdonai haaretz umeloah, da ara kaddisha, deikre eretz hachayyim. tevel veyoshve vah, da shear aran, kema deat amer (Tehillim 9:9) vehu yishpot tevel betzedek, detevel betzedek talya, vecholla chad milla.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, laAdonai haaretz umeloah. haaretz tinach, umeloah may hi. ella illen nishmatin detzaddikayyay. tevel veyoshve vah, tevel: da ara diltatta. veyoshve vah: illen innun bene nasha. amar ribbi yose, i hachi bemay okimna ki hu al yammim yesadah veal neharot yechonneha. amar leh vadday hachi hu, dehahi eretz hachayyim al yammim yesadah veal neharot yechonneha, dechullehu nafke mehahu nahar illaa denagid venafik meeden, uvehu ittekanat leitattera bemalka kaddisha, ulemezan almin. (uvegin kach)

Mi yaale vehar Adonai vegomer, neki chappayim uvar levav asher lo nasa lashshav nafshi vegomer. nafsho ketiv, mahu nafshi venafsho. ella kolla chad milla, kema deat amar (Amos 6) nishba Adonai benafsho (Shmuel 1 2:35) kaasher bilvavi uvenafshi yaase. vedavid malka itachid behahu lev uvehahu nefesh, veal da lo nasa lashshav nafsho.
Ad dahavo azle, iarau bechad bar nash, veanpoy malyayn machteshin, vahava kam mittechot ilana chad, istekalu beh, vechamu
1124: Anpoy sumakin beinnun machteshin. amar ribbi chiyyay man ant. amar leh yuday ana. amar ribbi yose chattaa hu, dei lav hachi, la itreshimu anpoy beillen marin bishin, veillen la ikrun yissurin deahava. amar ribbi chiyyay hachi hu vadday, deyisurin deahava mitchappeyayn innun mibbene nasha.

Ta chaze, dichtiv adam ki yihye veor besaro seet o sappachat o vaheret. ha 3 zinin hacha, vechullehu ikrun nega tzaraat, hada hu dichtiv vehaya veor besaro lenega tzaraat. may nega tzaraat. segiru. segiru becholla, uchetiv vehuva el aharon hakkohen vegomer. aval innun deyitchazun levar ketiv, veraahu hakkohen vetimme oto. deha vadday innun deyitchazun levar bivne nasha, missitra dimsaava ka atyayn, velav yissurin deahava ninhu.

Amar ribbi yose, mena lan. amar ribbi chiyyay, dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:5) tova tochachat megula meahava mesuttaret. e hahi tochachat meahava (sefer acher inhu tochachat meahava kad ihi), mesuttaret mibbene nasha. kegavvna da man deochach lechavreh birchimuta, bae leastera milloy mibbene nasha, dela yichsof minnayyhu chavreh, vei milloy innun beitgalyay kame bene nasha, lav innun birchimuta.

Kach kudesha berich hu kad ochach lebar nash, becholla ochach birchimuta, bekadmita mache leh begarmeh dilgo. i hadar beh, mutav. vei lav mache leh techot totveh, veillen (beoro) ikrun yissurin deahava, i hadar beh mutav, vei lav mache leh beitgalyay beanpoy, kame kolla, begin deyistakkelun beh, veyindeun deha chattaa ihu, velav rechima demareh hu.

Amar lon hahu bar nash, bekitra deeta chad atitun gabbay, vadday lav attun ella meinnun dediyyurehon beve ribbi shimon ben yochay dela dachalin mikkolla. i banay deatyayn avatray yekatregu bechu, ech millayychu beitgalyay. amar leh orayyta hachi hu, dichtiv, (Mishlei 1:21) berosh homiyyot tikra befitche shearim bair amareha tomer. uma i bemille deorayyta anan dachale mikkammach, ha nishtechach bechissufa kame kudesha berich hu. velo od, ella deorayyta bae tzachuta. patach hahu gavra veamar (Micha 7:18) mi el kamocha nose avon vegomer. arim yedoy uvacha. addehachi matun benoy. amar bereh zeera siyyayta dishmayyay hacha.

Patach veamar (Kohelet 7:15) et hakkol raiti bime hevli yesh tzaddik oved betzidko veyesh rasha maarich beraato. hay kera olifna be ribbi dostay sava, dehava amar mishshemeh deribbi yesa sava. et hakkol raiti bime hevli, vechi shelomo malka dehava chakkim al kolla, ech amar hachi deihu chama kolla bezimna deihu azil bachashoche alma deha kol man deishtedal bachashoche alma, la chame midi, vela yada midi.

Ella hachi ittemar, beyomoy dishlomo malka, kayyeyma sihara beashlemuta, veitchakkam shelomo al kol bene alma, ucheden chama kolla, veyada kolla. umay chama. chama kol, dela ade min sihara. vahava nahir lah shimsha (sefer acher leh keshimsha). hada hu dichtiv et hakkol raiti bime hevli. man hevli. da sihara deitkelilat min kolla, min mayya veeshsha verucha kachada. kehevel denafik min puma, dechalil mikkolla.

Vehu chama kol, behahu hevel dileh, deachid beh. yesh tzaddik oved betzidko, ta chaze, bezimna deasgiu zakkain bealma, hay kol la ade min sihara lealmin, vehay kol natal kol meshach urevu vechedu dilella, veitmelle (sefer acher yedoy veravvi) vechadde verabbe, begin leizdavvevga besihara, vehu ravavch beginah.

Uvezimna deasgiu chayyayvin bealma, vesihara itchashshechat, keden tzaddik oved betzidko, tzadik neevad la ketiv, ella tzaddik oved, deha la itchaze (nusach acher itchabbar) besihara, vela natil meshach urevu vechedu lemalyya lah, uleizdavvevga immah. veal da tzadik oved, betzidko, da sihara, divgin sihara dela ishtechachat leizdavvevga immeh, hu avid, dela shaiv mechedu kema dehava avid. ucheden kol setar semala ittear, vechayyayvin maarichin beshalva
1125: Bealma, hada hu dichtiv, veyesh rasha maarich beraato. may beraato behahu setar (nusach acher behahi raa) deitdevak beh.

Tu yesh tzaddik oved betzidko, dechad chayyayvin segiu bealma, vedina talya (bechovayyhu) tzaddik oved betzidko, ihu ittefas bechovayyhu, kegon abba deitpas bechovayyhu divne mateh, dahavo kullehu chatzifin (legabbeh), vehu la ashid behu vela achsif lehu lealmin, umache bidan, dela nitgere behu berashiayya (nusach acher velo mache bidehon dela mategarev behu). vahava amar lan, (Tehillim 37:1) ledavid al titchar bammereim al tekanne beose avla. amar avuy, vadday kudesha berich hu anish li beda, deha hava reshu bidi limchoa bidayyhu, vela avadit, vela achsifna (nusach acher avekaychanea) lehu, la bitmiru, vela beitgalya.

Tu patach bereh ochora veamar, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama vegomer. vayyitzer Adonai elohim, bitre yodin, bitren yitzrin, yetzer tov veyetzer ra, chad lokovel mayya, vechad lokovel eshsha. Adonai elohim, shem male. et haadam, kalil dechar venukeba. afar min haadama, da afra deara kaddisha, demittamman itbere, vehu atar deve makdesha.

Vayippach beappav nishmat chayyim, da nishmeta kaddisha, deitmashshecha meinnun chayyim dilella. vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya, adam itkelil benafsha kaddisha, mechayya illaa. deappikat ara dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya, nefesh dehahi chayya illaa.
Ta chaze, bechol zimna dehay nishmeta kaddisha, itdabbekat beh bevar nash. rechima hu demareh. kama neturin natrin leh mikkol sitrin, reshima hu letav leella vetatta, ushechinta kaddisha sharya aloy.

Uvezimna deihu aste archoy, shechinta istelakat minneh, venishmeta kaddisha la itdevakat beh. umissitra dechivya bisha takkifa, ittear rucha chad, deshat veazil bealma, dela sharya ella baatar dikdushsha illaa istellak mittamman. ucheden isteav bar nash, veitpegim bivsareh, bechezu deanpoy becholla.

Veta chaze, begin dehay nefesh chayya ihi kaddisha illaa, kad ara kaddisha mashcha lah, veitkelilat begavvav, keden karenan lah neshama. veda hi desalleka leella, umemallela kame malka kaddisha, veayyla bechol tarin, velet deyimche bidaha. veal da itkere rucha memallela, deha kol shear nafshata let lon reshu lemallela kame malka, bar hay.

Veal da orayyta achrizat veamrat, (Tehillim 34:14) netzor leshoncha mera vegomer, uchetiv (Mishlei 21:23) shomer piv uleshono vegomer, begin dei shifvavteh velishaneh memallelan millin bishin, innun millin sallekin leella, uveshaata desallekin, kolla machrizin veamrin istelaku missocharaneh demilla bisha diflanya, penun atar learcheh dechivya takkifa. keden nishmeta kaddisha itabbera minneh veistellakat, vela yachla lemallela, kema deat amer (Tehillim 39:3) neelamti dumiyya hechesheti mittov.

Vehahi nishmeta salleka bechissufa, beaku decholla, vela yahavin lah atar kemillekaddemin. veal da ketiv, shomer piv uleshono shomer mitztzarot nafsho. nafsho vadday hahi dahavat memallela, itavidat mashtuka, begin millula bisha. ucheden chivya izdeman, decholla leatreh ithaddar, vechad hahi milla bisha salleka beorchin yedian, veshari kammeh dechivya takkifa, kama ruchin mitarin bealma, verucha nachta mehahu sitra, veashkach dehahu bar nash ittear leh bemilla bisha, veha rucha memallela kaddisha itabbera minneh, keden sharya aloy vesaiv leh, ucheden hu sagir.

Kema deonsha dehay bar nash begin milla bisha. kach onsheh begin milla tava, dekate lideh, veyachil lemallela, vela mallil. begin defagim lehahu rucha memallela, dehi ittekanat lemallela leella, ulemallela letatta, vecholla bikdushsha. kol shekken i amma azlin beorcha akima, vehu yachil lemallela lehu uleochacha lehu, veshatik vela mallil, kama daamena dichtiv, neelamti dumiyya hechesheti mittov ucheevi nekar. nekar bemachteshin dimsaavuta, veda hu deamar david
1126: Malka alke behay, veitpene minneh, dichtiv, (Tehillim 25:16) pene elay vechanneni. mahu pene elay. kema deat amer (Bamidbar 12:10) vayyifen aharon. nachtu ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, uneshshakuhu. izdavvavgu kachada kol hahu orcha, kara ribbi chiyyay alayyhu, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech vaor ad nechon hayyom.

(Vayikra 13:9) nega tzaraat ki tihye beadam vehuva el hakkohen. amar ribbi yose, hay nega, kol gavvnin dileh ittearu behu chavrayyay, vechahana hava yada behu ledachya ulemsaava, hava yada, innun dahavo yissurin dirchimuta, o innun deishtechachu beman demais beh mareh verachik beh, deha lefum archoy debar nash garim nega bealma.

Ketiv (Tehillim 141:4) al tat libbi ledavar ra lehitolel alilot beresha, mikkan tanenan bearcha debar nash bae lemehach bah madberin leh. amar ribbi yitzchak, hay kera kashya, vechi kudesha berich hu aste leh levar nash lemehach beorach chattaa, ulemebad ovadin bishin, i hachi let dina bealma da, vela bealma deate, veorayyta la ittekanat, dichtiv bah im tishma veim lo tishma.

Ella david azhar lelibbeh, ledabbera leh beorach keshot, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:39) vahashevota el levavecha. may vahashevota. ella zimna chad, uteren, utelat, leahdara lokovleh, uledabbera, uleazhara leh. vehachi kaamar leh, al tat libbi ledavar ra, lelibbeh kaamar david (kelomar) al tat lefum orchoy debar nash (nusach acher vehachi kaamar leh, libbi, el tet ledabber ra) deha davar ra garim nega bealma, vedina sharya bealma, vehayeynu nega tzaraat.

Nega tzaraat, ha ittearu chavrayyay, aval tzaraat ketargumo, amar ribbi yehuda, may ketargumo. segiru, desagir vela patach, vechad sagir hu vela patach, nega hu deikkere. ribbi yose amar, dela mistappekin avahan, kol shekken benin. vehayeynu dichtiv nega tzaraat ki tihye beadam, baadam mammash, umikkan nachit leman denachit, ishtechach nega lecholla, mehahu segiru.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday da hu raza demilla, dichtiv, (Eicha 2:7) nier mikdasho. may tama. mishshum divne alma garmu hay, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:20) et mikdash Adonai timme, timme mammash. amar ribbi elazar, timme, mishshum deistalkat (shechinta minneh) man deistallak, vechivya takkifa sharya, veatil zuhama, vesaiv leman desaiv, vechullehu begin chove alma.

Tane, kad shaari chivya (takkifa) leitgallaa, mistallekin samchin uvinyaynin umitabberin, veate chivya takkifa veatil zuhama, ucheden ishtechach makdesha misav, man makdesha. kema deittemar (Vayikra 14:34) venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem. uchetiv (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum mikkol chayyat hassade asher asa Adonai elohim vayyomer el haishsha. el haishsha mammash, deatar makdesha itachid begavvav, vehayeynu et mikdash Adonai timme begin chovoy, mishshum deitgalya chivya takkifa.

Man chovoy. da lishana bisha, divgin lishana bisha, chivya izdaman, ben leella ben letatta, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:6) vayshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hasserafim. hasorfim o haserufim la ketiv, ella hasserafim, man serafim. dichtiv (Tehillim 74:13) rashe tanninim (tere, chad itachid leella, vechad letatta) (sefer acher tere, chad atechazerav lezimnin) uchetiv (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim mimmaal lo, mimmaal lo vadday, kema deat amer (Iyov 1) lehityatztzev al Adonai, ucheden segiru becholla, velet man defatach, veal da ketiv (Mishlei 30:20) ken derech ishsha menaafet achla umachata fiha vegomer, may menaafet. menaafet mammash vadday, achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti avn.

Amar ribbi chiyyay amar ribbi yitzchak, biruta decholla la ishtechach letatta, ella begin deishtechach leella. uleella la ishtechach, ella kad ishtechach letatta bechove alma, deyalfenan decholla talyay hay behay, vehay behay.

(Vayikra 13:40) veish ki yimmaret rosho vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar (Kohelet 2:13) veraiti ani sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut vegomer, bechamma atar istakkalna bemilloy dishlomo malka, veashgachna bechachmeta
1127: Saggia dileh, veastim milloy bego, lego hechala kaddisha. hay kera it leistakkela beh, amay amar veraiti ani, vechi shear bene alma la yade vela chaman da. afillu man dela yada chachmeta min yomoy, vela ashgach bah, yada hay sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut kitron haor min hachoshech. vehu shabbach garmeh veamar raiti ani.

Ella hachi tana, man chakkim kishlomo divshiva dargin dechachma itkere kegavvna dilella. shita yomin leella, sheviaa illaa alayyhu. shita yomin letatta, sheviaa alayyhu. shita dargin lechuresyay, hu al kuresyay, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:23) vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech. shiva kitrin deyomin leella, ucheden lokovlehon shiva shemahan lishlomo. leitchazaa beh chachmeta kaddisha. uvegin kach itkere sheva shemahan: shelomo. yedidya. agur. ben yake. lemuel, itiel, kohelet.

Veamar shiva havalim. uma deihu chama la chama bar nash ochora, vechad kanash chachmeta veistallak bedargin dechachmeta, ikre kohelet. veshiva havalin amar, lokovel 7 kitrin dilella, vechol hevel kala itavid minneh, vealma la mitkayyeyma ella bahevel.

Vetana mishshemeh derabbi shimon, hevel appik kala berucha umaya deveh, velet kala ella bahevel. vetana beshiva havalin itkayyeymin illain vetattain. vetane ribbi yitzchak, ta chaze, deal hevel mitkayyem alma, deilmale la hava haval denafik mippuma, la itkayyaym bar nash afillu shaata chada.

Kegavvna da amar shelomo milloy, dealma mitkayyeyma behu, dehay hevel demitkayem beh alma. vehay hevel demitkayem beh alma, mehavalim dilella kaate, hada hu dichtiv havel havalim, havel mehavalim dilella. vechol milloy hachi havo. uvahavalim dilella ketiv, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motza fi Adonai yichye haadam. may motza fi Adonai. da havalim dilella.

Vetanya, veraiti ani sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut. min hassichlut mammash, ate toalta lechachmeta, deilmale la ishtechach shetuta bealma, la ishtemoda chachmeta umilloy. (tikun 123 amud alef) vetana chiyyuva hu al bar nash deolif chachmeta, lemelaf zeer min shetuta, uleminda lah. begin deate toalta lechachmeta begineh. kema deatya toalta linhora mechashocha, deilmale chashocha la ishtemoda nehora. vela atyay (nusach acher itchazya) toalta lealma minneh.

Tana sheyyesh yitron lachachma, lachachma setam. deamar ribbi shimon leribbi abba, ta chaze raza demilla, la nahir chachmeta dilella, vela itnehir, ella begin shetuta deittear meatar ochora, veilmale hay, nehiru urevu sagi veyattir la hava (leheve), vela itchazya toalta dechachmeta. uvegin shetuta itnehir yattir, unehirin leh yattir, hada hu dichtiv sheyyesh yitron lachachma, lachachma setam, min hassichlut setam. vechach letatta, ilmale la hava shetuta shechiach bealma, la havi chachmeta shechiach bealma.

Vehayeynu derav hamenuna sava, kad havo yalfin minneh chavrayyay raze dechachmeta, hava mesadder kamayyhu pirka demille dishtuta, begin deyete toalta lechachmeta begineh. hada hu dichtiv (Kohelet 10:1) yakar mechachma umikkavod sichlut meat, mishshum dehi tikkuna dechachmeta, vikara dechachmeta. veal da ketiv, velibbi noheg bachachma veleechoz besichlut.

Ribbi yose amar yakar mechachma umikkavod, kelomar yekara dechachmeta venoy dilah, vikara dechavod dilella, may hi. sichlut meat. zeer dishtuta achze vegalle yekara dechachmeta vechavod dilella, yattir mikkol archin dealma.

Keyitron haor min hachoshech, toalta dinhora la atyay (nusach acher itchazya) ella min chashocha. (uleolam) tikkuna dechivvavra may hi. uchama, ilmale uchama la ishtemoda chivvavra, uvegin uchama, istalik chivvavra veityakar. amar ribbi yitzchak, mashal lematok bemar, dela yada eynash taama dimtika, ad detaim merira, man avid lehay metika. hevi omer hay merira. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:14) gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim. uchetiv
1128: (Kohelet 7:18) tov asher teechoz baze vegam mizze al tannach yadecha.

Tana bechamma dargin itkere bar nash: adam, gever, enosh, ish. gadol shebbechullam adam. (mishshum) dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo. uchetiv (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. vela ketiv, gever, enosh, ish. amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi, veha ketiv (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. (velo gevar, enosh, ish) man bae lemikrav karbena. man deihu chattaa uchetiv adam.

Amar ribbi yitzchak ta chaze, kiyyuma dealma deillain vetattain, hu karbena. nayycha dekudesha berich hu. uman itchaze lemikrav kammeh hay nayycha, hevi omer hay adam, deyakkira mikkolla. amar leh i hachi, ha ketiv, adam ki yihye veor besaro vegomer, vehaya veor besaro lenega tzaraat. amar leh, lehay bae kudesha berich hu ledakkaa yattir mikkolla, deman deihu bedarga illaa dechullehu, la litiv hache.

Uvegin kach ketiv baadam, vehuva el hakkohen. uva la ketiv, ella vehuva, dechol man dechame leh, itchayyayv beh leakrove kame kahana, dediyyukena kaddisha la letiv hachi. uchetiv ish o ishsha ki yihye vo naga vegomer, veish o ishsha ki yihye beor besaram beharot vegomer, vela ketiv behu vehuva.

Amar leh, veha ketiv (Bamidbar 12:3) vehaish moshe, (Shemot 32:1) ki ze moshe haish, amay la ikre adam. amar leh mishshum deikre eved lemalka, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:7) lo chen avdi moshe. (Yehoshua 1:2) moshe avdi. veof hachi ikre ish legabbe adam dilella. amar leh i hachi, veha ketiv (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama, vela ketiv adam. amar leh (tehillim ko) sod Adonai lireav. amar leh i hachi ana benayyhu (sefer acher yativ) ativu becholla, uvaatar da la zachina.

Amar leh zil leribbi abba, daana olifna minneh al menat dela legallaa. azal legabbe deribbi abba, ashkacheh dehava darish veamar, ematay itkere shelemuta dilella (nusach acher decholla), kad yativ kudesha berich hu bechuresyyay. vead dela yativ bechuresyyay, la ishtechach shelemuta. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala, mashma dichtiv adam, dehu kelala, ushelemuta decholla. amar ribbi yehuda, berich rachamana deashkachit lach behay. amar leh i hachi ha ketiv (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama, vela ketiv adam. amar leh yaut shaalta.

Ta chaze, hatam la ishtechach shelemuta decholla, uvegine kach ikre ish. aval hacha, shelemuta decholla, uchelala decholla, begin kach ikre adam. kare aleh (Tehillim 119:72) tov li torat picha mealfe zahav vachasef.

Tu amar leh, ketiv (tehillim lo) adam uvehema, vela ketiv ish uvehema. amar leh vela. vehakketiv (Shemot 11:7) lemeish vead behema. aval ma dichtiv adam uvehema, kema dichtiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:13) min haerez asher ballevanon ad haezov asher yotze bakkir. orcheh dikra hu, denakit illaa mekullehu, venamich mekullehu. uf hacha illaa decholla, adam, venamich mikkolla behema.

Amar leh veha ketiv (Bereshit 2:Adonai) veadam ayin laavod et haadama. amar leh, ta chaze, dechol ma di bealma la havi ella begineh deadam, vechullehu begineh mitkayyeyme, vela itchaziu bealma, vechullehu itakkevu ad deyete hahu deikre adam. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:Adonai) vechol shiach hassade terem yihye vaaretz vegomer. terem: ad la, ketargumo. mishshum dediyyukena illaa la itchaze, hada hu dichtiv veadam ayin, kelomar, kullehu itakkevu begineh dehay diyyukena, ad deitchaze. uvegin kach la itchaze (nusach acher itbere) hay diyyukena, ella bediyyukena deitchaze leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam, beshem malle. kema deokimna, deihu shelemuta decholla, uchelala decholla.

Tana, bashshishshi nivra adam, beshaa shennishlam hakkise. venikra kisse, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lakkisse. ulefichach nivra haadam bashshishshi, shehu rauy leshev al hakkisse. vetana kevan denivra adam ittakkan kolla, vechol ma dilella vetatta, vecholla itkelil baadam.

Tanya amar ribbi yose, ketiv (Yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam, kelala decholla, vecholla kelilan behay diyyukena. amar ribbi yehuda veha ketiv (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene arye el hayamin learbatam, ufene shor
1129: Mehassemol learbatan, amar leh kolla appe adam havo, uvehahu diyyukena deadam, itchazyayn kol gavvnin vechol diukenin. kema detanenan anpoy anpe nishra, la dehu nishra, ella deitchaze bediyyukena deadam, mishshum dekalil kol gavvnin vechol diukenin.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ta chaze, kol man deihu techot shuletane deadam, itkere ish. mishshum deittakan begavvna deadam, middarga ochora dehava beh bekadmita. detanya beraza illaa (teruma 178 amud bet, 46 amud bet) besifra ditzniuta, kad itbere adam, nachat bediyyukena kaddisha illaa, venachtu immeh teren ruchin, mitteren sitrin, mimina umissemala, kelala deadam. verucha dimina, itkere nishmeta kaddisha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim. verucha dismala, itkere nefesh chayya, vahava azil venachit meella letatta, vela ityayshva bahade ochora.

Kad hava ayyil shabbeta, vahava chav adam, itavidu (nusach acher itnegidu) mehahu rucha semala, biryayn mitpashshetan bealma, vela isteyaymu gufa dilhon. veitchabbaru behay gufa deadam, bidchura venukeba, veityelidu bealma. veillen ikrun nige bene adam. (25 amud alef) tana, illain minnayyhu dela itdevaku letatta, vetalyayn baavira, veshamin ma deshamin milleella. uminnayyhu yadin innun ochoranin letatta.

Tana, min butzina dekardinuta, nafkin telat mea veesrim vechamesh nitzotze, mitgallefin umitachadan kachada missitra digvura, deikrun gevurot, (sefer acher vametalekaden) kachada, veitavidu chad. (gufa) vechad ayylin illen begufa, ikre ish. (sefer acher velo ish da) da detanenan ish tam veyashar ish tzaddik, veish dehacha, ish milchama ketiv, decholla salik dina, vecholla chada. amar ribbi yehuda amay. la hava bideh (derabbi yitzchak). atu shailu kameh derabbi shimon, amar lon, tu kashya, deha tanenan ketiv (Bereshit 2:23) lezot yikkare ishsha ki meish lukocha zot, vetanenan man ish da chesed, vehacha amrittu dehu dina.

Ella hachi tana, kolla hu bechad matkela salleka, vecholla chad. umishshum dedine tattae mitachadan (nusach acher vametalekaden) umitchabberan besaaroy dehay. ikre hu dina kashya, vechad itabbar minneh saara deresha, itbesam, vedinin diltatta la izdemanu. uvegin kach ikre tahor. dela ikre tahor, ella kad nafik missitra dimsaava, vechad nafik min misava, ikre tahor. dichtiv, (Iyov 14:4) mi yitten tahor mittame. mittame vadday, vehacha ketiv, veish ki yimmaret rosho kereach hu tahor hu.

Veta chaze, beresha dehay ish, butzina dekardinuta. uvegin kach gulegalta deresha dehay, sumaka kolla kevavrda, vesare sumake bego sumake, vetalyayn minneh kitrin tattain diltatta, demitarin dinin bealma. vechad itabbar minneh saara veitgelish, mechesed illaa itbesam kolla, veitkere tahor al shemeh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i itkere al shemeh, kadosh itkere, vela tahor. amar leh lav hache, dekadosh la itkere ella kad tale saara. dikdushsha besara tale, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 6:Adonai) kadosh yihye gadel pera sear rosho. vehay ikre tahor, missitra detalyayn letatta mineh, uvegine kach itabbar minneh saara, veitdachya.

Veta chaze kol man deihu missitra dedina, vedinin mitachadin beh, la itdache, ad deitavar minneh saara, umiditavar minneh saara itdache. vei tema adam. lav hachi, deha hu shelemuta decholla, verachame ishtechachu beh. begin kach lav hachi dechullehu kedushan vekaddishin ityaychadu beh. aval hay, hu dina, vedine itachadan beh, la itbesam ad deitavar minneh saara.

Ta chaze, deha levae deatu mehay sitra dedina, la mitdakkean ad deitavaru minnehon saara, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 8:7) vecho taase lahem letaharam hazze alehem me chattat veheeviru taar al kol besaram vegomer. uvegin deyitbassemun yattir, bae kahana deata missitra dechesed illaa, learama lon, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 8:11) vehenif aharon et haleviyyim tenufa lifne Adonai. kema deihu lehay ish dilella, dechad bae leitbassema
1130: Yattir, itgalyay beh chesed illaa, veitbesam. umevassem hu, letatta.

Vehay ish bichlala deadam hu. vechad bae kudesha berich hu leaggacha kerava, behay ish agach behu kerava, dichtiv (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama, behay ish mammash. vela agach behu kerava, ad deabar leh saara deresha, begin deyishtalshelun mishshilshulehon, veyittabberun kol innun kitrin demitachadan besaare. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 7:20) bayom hahu yegallach Adonai vegomer. beevre nahar bemelech ashshur et harosh vesaar haraglayim vegam et hazzakan tispe.

Tana, vecho taase lahem letaharam. may vecho. kegavvna dilella, hazze alehem me chattat, shiyyure talla divdolcha hacha me chattat, deinnun shiyyure talla. lezimna deate ketiv, (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim. vechibbesu vigdehem, kegavvna dilella, detikunoy dehay ish itsachan bechesed illaa veitdakke mikkolla.

Vetanenan, amay ketiv betaar velo bemisperayim. ella mishshum deyitavar saara besharshoy, veyitabberun mineh dinin tattain mishshuleshulehon. ulezimna deyitkashrun ovadin letatta, zammin kudesha berich hu saara da leabera leh, ulemiglesheh begin dela yitzmach veyirbe, dichtiv ki yimmaret rosho.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, rav mikkol levae, korach hava, deavdeh kudesha berich hu letatta, kegavvna dilella, vekaryeh korach. ematay. beshaata degalish begineh lehay ish, dichtiv kereach hu.

Vechad chama korach resheh bela saara, vechama leaharon mitkashshet bekishute malchin, itzalzal beeneh vekinne leaharon. amar leh kudesha berich hu, ana avadit lach kegavvna dilella, la baat lealaa beillain, chut letatta vahavi betattain. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 16:30) veyardu chayyim sheola. may ihu sheol. gehinnam. detamman tzavvchin chayyayvin, velet man dimrachame alayyhu. uzeminin innun leachayay uleaala, kad yittear kudesha berich hu leammeh, uleachayay lehu. dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:6) Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal.

(Vayikra 13:41) veim mippeat panav yimmaret rosho. tana, it panim veit panim, uman panim hallalu. illen innun deikrun panim shel zaam. vechol illen detalyayn meinnun panim chatzifin, kullehu takkifin. kullehu dela merachame, vechad itabbar saara missitra deinnun panim, mitabberan kullehu veittebaru.

Detanya, (131 amud bet, 141) kol innun detalyayn missaara deresha, innun illain al ochoranin, vela chatzifin kevavtayyhu. vechol innun detalyayn missitra desaara deinnun panim, kullehu chatzifin vetakifin, uvegin kach anpoy mitlahatan keeshsha, mishshum nitzotza devutzina dekardinuta. uvehay ketiv, (Eicha 4) pene Adonai chillekam. (Tehillim 34:17) pene Adonai beose ra.

Amar ribbi yitzchak mahu nega lavan adamdam. nega mammash hu, i chivvavra itchaze, vesumaka la itabbar. mashma dichtiv lavan adamdam. amar ribbi yose, dechivvavra la itchaze ella besumaka, kegavvna chivvavra vesumaka. ribbi yitzchak amar, af al gav dechivvavra itchaze, i sumaka la azil, nega hu. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu. vechad itchavvavr, kolla rachame ishtechachu, vedinin la ishtechachu. (sefer acher deha itakaru)
Tane ribbi abba, ketiv nega hu, uchetiv nega hi. chad dechar vechad nukeba. ella kad nukeba, isteavat begin chove tattae, ketiv nega hi. vechad dechar la itdache begin chove tattae, ketiv nega hu.

Veishtemodan millin illen legabbe kahana, dinin deatu mehay, vedinin deatu mehay. veishtemodan karbane devayayn lekarva, dichtiv zachar tamim. uchetiv nekeva temima yevienna, deha ishtemodan mile, mean atu dinin, umean innun chove. deitachadan behay o behay. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara. leappaka shear karbenin dela ketiv ruach nishbara, deinnun shelama lealma, vechedva deillain vetattain.
(Vayikra 13:21) veim yirenna hakkohen. tane ribbi yose, ketiv
1131: (Tehillim 65:3) shomea tefilla adecha vegomer. shomea tefilla, da kudesha berich hu. ribbi chizkiyya amar, shomea tefilla, shomea tefillot mibbae leh, mahu shomea tefilla. ella tefilla, da keneset yisrael, deihi tefilla, dichtiv, (Tehillim 109:4) vani tefilla (sefer acher 2 vaani tefillati) vedavid begin cheneset yisrael kaamar lah. uma deamar vaani tefilla, kolla chad, veal da shomea tefilla, veda tefilla shel yad, dichtiv, (Shemot 13) al yadcha beHei.

Adecha kol basar yavou. beshaata degufa sharya betzaara, bemarin bemachteshin. kema deat amer uvasar ki yihye veoro. et hannega beor habbasar. habbasar hachay. uvegin kach la ketiv, kol ruach yavou, ella kol basar yavou. mahu adecha. ella kema deittemar, vehuva el hakkohen, da hu kudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, veim yirenna hakkohen. ta chaze, baatar chad aharon hakkohen, uveatra ochora hakkohen setam, veda kudesha berich hu.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, veha ketiv nega tzaraat ki tihye beadam vehuva el hakkohen, i hachi da kudesha berich hu. amar leh in. begin deveh talya kol dachyuta vechol kedushsha. amar leh, i hachi, amay vehuva, vehuala mibbae leh. amar leh, kema deat amer (Shemot 27:7) vehuva et baddav battabbaot, deayil da bego da. uf hacha vehuva, deyikkansun leh lechahana, ledakkea leh (24 ahdar beh) veyealun milla kammeh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, hachi tanenan, nega tzaraat. nega hu dina takkifa sharya bealma. tzaraat: segiru. kema deat amer, segiru dinhora illaa. segiru detivu illaa, dela nachit lealma. ki tihye beadam, beadam setam. vehuva el hakkohen. da kohen diltatta, dehu ittekkan lemiftach hahu segiru, uleadlaka butziniya deyishtechachu al yedoy birchan leella uletatta. veyitavar veyistalak hahu nega, veyishre nehiru derachame al kolla, uvegin kach vehuva el hakkohen.

Amar ribbi abba, chamena leinhu bene alma, dela mashgechan, vela yadin bikara demarehon, ketiv behu beyisrael, (Vayikra 20:24) asher hivdalti etchem min haammim lihyot li. uchetiv, (Vayikra 20:24) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai. i innun mitrachakan, an hu kedushsha dilhon, ha reuta dilhon itrachakat minneh. ukera achriz veamar, (Tehillim 32:9) al tihyu kesus kefered en havin, bema itparshan bene nasha missus vafered, bikdushsha degarmayyhu, leishtakkecha shelemin ureshimin mikkolla.

Veal da ziuuga divne nasha hu bezimnin yedian, lechavvevna reuta leitdabbeka beh bekudesha berich hu. veha ittearu, befalgut lelya kudesha berich hu al beginta deeden, leishtashea im tzaddikayyay, ukkeneset yisrael meshabbachat leh lekudesha berich hu, vehi shaata diruta leitdabbeka behu.

Vechavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, mishtattefe bah bikkeneset yisrael, leshabbecha lemalka kaddisha, veitassekan beorayyta, shear bene nasha keden iddan reuta leitkaddesha bikdushsha dekudesha berich hu, ulechavvevna reuta leitdabbeka beh. veinnun chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta ziuuga dilhon beshaata deziuuga ochora ishtechach, vehay mishshabbat leshabbat lechavvevna reuta leitdabbeka beh bekudesha berich hu uvichneset yisrael, dehu iddan reuta demitbarchan kolla illae vetattae.

I bene nasha itrachaku minneh, veavdan kivire, an hu kedushsha dilhon, leishtakkecha kaddishin. an innun nafshaan kaddishin demashchan meella. ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar, (Mishlei 19:2) gam belo daat nefesh lo tov. gam belo daat, man hu daat. da kudesha berich hu. nefesh lo tov, da hu nefesh, deinnun mashchin beovadayyhu, lo tov, deha missitra ochora itmashshechan alayyhu nafshata delav ihu tov, begin dela mechavvevne libbayyhu lekudesha berich hu.

Man deitlehit beyetzer hara, bela reuta vechavvavna delibba lekudesha berich hu. missitra deyetzer hara itmeshach aleh nafsha, delav ihi tov, hada hu dichtiv gam belo daat nefesh lo tov veatz beraglayim chote. man deihu atz beraglayim vedache shaata bela reuta kaddisha, chote. chote vadday, becholla.
Veal da sharyayn machteshin bishin bivne nasha, veashidu beanpayyhu bachatzifuta dilhon, leachazaa deha kudesha berich hu mais behu, velav dateh behon, ad deinnun zakkan
1132: Umachsheran ovadayyhu kemillekaddemin, umitbarchan (sefer acher vametadekaan). veal da ishtemodan machteshin legabbe kahana, innun deatyayn missitra dimsaava, veinnun deatyayn missitra ochora.

Kegavvna da ketiv, ki tavou el eretz kenaan vegomer, venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem. vechi agar tav hu, deyishtechach beinnun dezakkan lemeal beara. ella ha ukemuha leashkecha matmonin deatmeran bevetayyhu, uleahanaa lon leyisrael.

Aval ta chaze, zakkain innun yisrael, deinnun mitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, vekudesha berich hu rachim lehu, dichtiv, (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai. umiggo rechimuta dileh, ail lehu leara kaddisha, leashraa shechinteh benayyhu, ulemehevi diyyureh immehon, veyisrael deyishtakkechun kaddishin al kol bene alma.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Shemot 35:26) vechol hannashim asher nasa libban vegomer. beshaata dahavo avdin avidta, havo amre, da lemakdesha. da lemashkena. da lefarochta. vechen kol innun umenin begin deyishre kedushsha al yedayyhu, veitkaddash hahu avidta. vechad salik leatreh, bikdushsha salik.

Kegavvna da man deavid avidta leavoda zara, o lesitra ochora, dela kaddisha. kevan deidkar leh al hahu avidta, ha ruach misava sharya aloy, vechad salik avidta, bimsaava salik. kenaaniyim palche leavoda zara inhu, umitdabbekan kullehu kachada beruach misava beavoda zara, vahavu binyayn banin lefartzufayyhu (sefer acher latenavepayyhev) ulegiulayyhu listar misava leavoda zara, vechad sharan lemivne, havo amre milla, vechevan deitdechar befumayyhu, salik aleh ruach misava. kad istalik avidta, beruach misava istalik.

Kevan dealu yisrael leara, baa kudesha berich hu ledakkea lon, ulekaddesha lon ara, uleafnaa atar lishchinta dela tishre shechinta go misava. veal da behahu nega tzaraat, havo satrin binyaynin deain vaavanin deitavedu bimsaavu.

Ta chaze, i ovada da hava leashkecha matmonin bilchodoy, yehadrun avanin levatar kema deinnun leatrayyhu, veafra leatreh. aval kera ketiv, vechilletzu et haavanim. uchetiv veafar acher yikkach. begin deyitabbar ruach misava, veyitpene veyitkaddash hasheta kemillekaddemin, veyishtechachu yisrael bikdushsha, uvediyyura kaddisha, lemishre benayyhu shechinta.

Veal da man devane binyan kad share lemivne, bae leadkera befumeh, deha lefulechana dekudesha berich hu hu bane. begin dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 22:13) hoy bone veto belo tzedek vegomer, ucheden siyyayta dishmayya share aloy, vekudesha berich hu zammin aleh kedushata, vekari aleh shalom, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov Adonai:24) veyadata ki shalom oholecha vegomer. mahu (Iyov Adonai:24) ufakadta navcha, ha ukemuha, aval ufakadta, leafkeda milla befuma kad ihu bane. ucheden velo techeta ketiv. vei lav ha zammin leveteh sitra ochora.

Kol shekken, man devane ureuteh begavvna ochora, begin dimyached beta lesitra ochora, leistaava beh. ha vadday sharya beh ruach misava, vela nafik hahu bar nash mealma, ad deitanash behahu beta, uman dedayir beh, yachil leatzeka, deha hahu dira ruach misava sharya beh, veazik man deishtechach beh.

Vei tema bema yedia. kegon deittezak behahu beta, hahu devane lah, o anshe beteh, o benizke degufa, o benizke mamona, hu uteren ochoranin avatreh. ha vadday yaarok bar nash letura, vela yadur beh. yadur betichala deafra, vela yadur beh.

Uvegin kach, kudesha berich hu chas alayyhu deyisrael, deinnun la yadin milla bechol innun bate. vehu amar, attun la yadin, ana yedana, vearshimna lon benega. nega dayir beveta, ha nega ochora takkifa, deyappik leh, veyyaabbar leh min alma. ucheden venatatz et habbayit et avanav veet etzav. kevan deazil leh, may taama venatatz et habbayit. ella bechol zimna dehahu binyan lihevi kayyaym,
1133: Hay beara kaddisha, kol shekken beara ochora, dizmina ruach misava yattir, veyachil bar nash leitzeka. amar ribbi elazar, vekol shekken deikre biklippoy dechavroy ochoranin, leishtakkecha tamman, vaafillu turefe dekaspeta la maberan leh mehahu beta, uvegin kach hay kera achriz veamar, hoy bone veto belo tzedek. hoy vadday kaamre kol yoma behahu beta.

Ribbi yose al chad yoma bechad beta, mata bassifta (sefer acher atrach betifsa), al lego. shama chad kala deamar, itkenashu ulu, ha chad pelugeta dilan. siftu venanzik leh ad la yinpok, amru, la nechul ella i diyyureh hacha. nafak ribbi yose vedachil. amar, vday man deabar al milloy dechavrayyay, itchayyayv benafsheh.

Amar leh ribbi chiyay, veha goyim ushear bene nasha dayyeyre begavvih, veishtelimu. amar leh, innun missitrayyhu ka atyayn, aval man dedachil chattaa, yachil leatzeka. vaafillu innun, i yeakkevu diyyurehon beh, la yifkun bishlam. amar leh, veha ketiv (Iyov 21:9) battehem shalom mippachad. amar leh kegon dehava meochora, veitbene mitztzedek. vekra hachi hu, battehem shalom mippachad, keshebbattehem shalom mippachad shevet eloah la sharya alehem.

(Vayikra 14:35) uva asher lo habbayit vehiggid vegomer. vehiggid, vayyomer mibbae leh, o vaydabber, mahu vehiggid. ella bechol atar milla dechachmeta hu, veha ukemuha. kenega nira li babbayit, kenega, nega mibbae leh. nira li, yesh li mibbae leh. deha ketiv, venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzatchem, deyitchaze lecholla. amay kenega nira li.

Ella beshaata dehay ayyil, ochora itgalya. umekatrega da beda. veal da nira li, hahu deitkasse itgalya, udeitgalya itkasse, ulevatar mitchaze leh bediyyukena dehahu nega deveta, veitkasseya ochora. veal da vehiggid lakkohen, demilla dechachmeta hi.

Ucheden ate kahana, veyirmun beta, veyintetzun leh avanin veain vecholla. kevan deintetzan veitdachan kolla, mitbarchan, keden ketiv, (Devarim 8:12) uvattim tovim tivne veyashavta. illen ikrun tovim, deha kadmae lav innun tovim, velav bichlala dikdushsha vedachyu ninhu.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi bemay mukemenan kera dichtiv, (Devarim 6:11) uvattim meleim kol tuv asher lo milleta. i ruach misava sharya begavavyyhu hech meleim kol tuv. amar ribbi elazar, meleim kol tuv: bemamona, bechaspa, uvedahava, uvecholla. kema deat amer (Bereshit 45:8) ki tuv kol eretz mitzrayim. veamar ribbi yehuda, veha kol batte demitzrae, malleyayn charshin vetaavavn havo. ella begin utera deara ittemar. uf hacha begin utera umamona hu.

Teren uterin natlu yisrael, chad kad nafku miggaluta demitzrayim. vechad kad alu leara. ribbi shimon amar, kol da vadday hava leitkadsha ara, uleabera ruach misava meara, umiggo yisrael. vechad beta hava natitz, hava ishtechach bah mamona, lemivne leh, ulemalya beteh, begin dela yitztaer al beta, veyishrun bediyyura dikdushsha.

(Vayikra 13:38) veish o ishsha ki yihye veor besaram beharot vegomer. ribbi yose amar, kesilta demokfe bevaheret azza, chezo tanena, uvechezo ittedan, beinnun gavvnin. amar ribbi yitzchak 300 tame it man degaris bevaheret azza. vechullehu olifna meabba, bar chezur (chivar) chad saiv, sahada chad. teren, tere sahade, vedache. mikkan ulehala, afillu mea kitre, utere kemea. veda olifna levatar dichtiv, (Devarim 19:15) lo yakum ed echad beish vegomer, al pi shenayim edim vegomer.

Ribbi chizkiyya hava yativ kammeh deribbi shimon, amar, ketiv nega lavan adamdam, keden hu nega, deha chivvavra la kaim beeneh. patach rabbi shimon veamar, ketiv (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim vegomer, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu bae ledakkea lon becholla, begin dela yishtakkechun bedina kammeh. umarehon dedina la yishletun behon, deha kolla azil batar zineh. sumaka lesumaka, vechivvavra lechivvavra. yemina limina, usemala lismala.
Beesav ketiv, (Bereshit 25:25) vayetze harishon admoni, veal da sharya beh zineh.
1134: Vei tema admoni ketiv beesav. uchetiv beh bedavid, (Shmuel 1 16:12) vayviehu vehu admoni. ella da mizzohama dedahava itavid, veda bezohara dedahava itdevak, beesav ketiv beh, admoni kullo keadderet sear, (48 amud bet) bezuhama dehitucha nafak. beh ketiv bedavid, im yefe enayim vetov roi.

Ta chaze, may tama. gavvna chivvavra ishtemoda, vegavvna sumaka ishtemoda, sumaka bekadmita, veha itchaze beh chivvavra, ha dachyuta ityeylid beh, veshari leitdakkea. chivvavra bekadmita, veitchazze beh sumaka, ha share leistaava, uchetiv vetimmeo hakkohen, deha ityeylid beh sumaka, leistaava. vechahana hava yada bechol innun gavvnin. ulezimnin deitchaze beh gavvna dedachyuta, veyasgir leh lemecheme i ityeylid beh gavvna ochora. vei la, madke leh, hada hu dichtiv vetiharo hakkohen vegomer.

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle bearcha, amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv (Melachim 2 Adonai:27) vetzaraat naaman tidbak becha uvezaracha leolam vegomer, i hu chata benoy amay yilkun. amar leh, elisha yattir mishshear nevie chama. chama dela nafik migechazi bera dimalya, veal da layit lechullehu.

Velo od, ella amar leh, ana pulechana beshimusha illaa legabbe eliyyahu, vezachena bitren chulakin, deha pelachna leh bikshot, veant rasha pegimat li, umet leshikra, vachamidat, ha avarta al orayyta kolla, uman deabar al da, mit hu lealma deate. aval begin defalchat li, shimmusha dilach la lihevi lemaggana, tehevi mita dilach bealma den, uvealma deate la. uvegin kach, vetzaraat naaman tidbak becha uvezaracha. (gavvna dacheyvevarea ishtemoda, ugevavna dasevamekaa ishtemoda)

Amar ribbi yose, beged hatztzemer o happishtim amay. amar ribbi yitzchak, becholla sharya, uvecholla shalta. veit kegavvna da dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:13) darsha tzemer ufishtim. uvegine kach, shuletaneh dehahu nega denafik meatar illaa, da shalta becholla, bitre gavvne, betzemer uvefishtim. uvegin kach, zot torat nega hatztzaraat beged hatztzemer o happishtim.

Ribbi yitzchak hava azil lekatfure daavoy. chama chad bar nash, desate bekutera dematula achatfoy. amar leh, shureta dekishta bechatfach amay, la amar leh midi. azal avatreh, chama deayyil bimarta chada, al avatreh, chama ketura ditnana dehava salik mittechot ara, veal hahu bar nash benukeba chad, veitkasya minneh. dachil ribbi yitzchak, venafak lefum mearta.

Ad dehava yativ, aberu ribbi yehuda veribbi chizkiyya, chama lon, vekariv gabbehon, sach lon ovada. amar ribbi yehuda, berich rachamana deshezvach. hay mearta desagir, disronya hi, vechol yatve hahi karta, charshin innun, veatyayn lemadbera lechivvyayn uchamin, deinnun bene eser shenin, o yattir, lemebad charshin, vela menatra minnayyhu, veitavidu segirin vechol zayyne charshin dilhon behay mearta innun.

Azlu, ad dahavo azle, iraru bechad bar nash dehava ate, uvereh dehava mera, katir al chamara. amru leh man at. amar leho yuday, veda hu beri deihu katir al chamara. amru leh, amay hu katir. amar lon diuri hu bechad kefar, deihu mibbene romae, vehay beri hava olif orayyta bechol yoma, vahava ahdar leveta, velae lon leinnun millin. veg shenin hava diuri behahu beta, vela chamena midi. vehasheta yoma chad al beri leveta leahaddera millin, abar chad rucha kameh, venazik leh, aakam pumeh veenoy, vidoy itakamu, vela yachil lemallela. vaatena legabbe mearta disgiru disronya dilma yillefun li milla deasuvta.
1135: Beta yadat min kadmat dena, deitnezak beh bar nash ochora. amar leh yedana, deha mikkamma yomin itnezak beh chad bar nash, vahavu amre demara hava, uminnayyhu amre derucha deveta, ulevatar alu beh kama bene nasha, vela itneziku. amru, hayeynu deamre chavrayyay, vavy leinun deavrin al millayyhu.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar, (Yirmeyahu 22:13) hoy bone veto belo tzedek, deha bechol atar deishtechach beh tzedek, kol ruchin vechol mazzike alma arke minneh, vela mishtakkeche kammeh. veim kol da, man deakdim venatil atar, achid beh. amar leh ribbi chizkiyya, i hachi shakil shema kaddisha keruach misava.

Amar leh, lav hachi, ella shema kaddisha la sharya baatar misava, uvegin kach, i shema kaddisha natil atar mikkadmat dena, kol ruchin vechol mazzikin dealma la yachlin leitchazaa beh, kol shekken lekarva bahadeh. i ruach misava kadim, natil atar. shema kaddisha la sharya beh, deha lav atreh.

Vechad hava nachit nega tzaraat, hava madke atra, veappik leruach misava meatreh, ulevatar menattetze beta, avanin veain vecholla, uvane lah kemillekaddemin, bistar kaddisha betzedek, dedachir leh lishma kaddisha, velishre aleh kedushsha, veim kol da beafra ochora, veyarchik beta meatreh, miyyesoda kadmaa tere tefachim.

Hasheta dela itchaze, vela nachit man dimkatreg beh behahu ruach misava, leappaka leh meatreh, may takante. i yachil lenafka mehay beta shappir. vei lav yivne leh kemillekaddemin, baavanin ochoranin, veain vecholla, veyappik veyarchik leh meatar kadmaa, veyivne leh al shema kaddisha.

Veim kol da, la nafik hahu rucha min atar kadmaa, begin dikdushsha la sharya al atar misava. amar ribbi yitzchak lamma leh leatrecha kule hay, bezimna da ketiv, (Kohelet 1:15) meuvvavt lo yuchal litkon vegomer. miyyoma deitcharav be makdesha, la ishtechach asuvta bealma, begine kach bae bar nash leizdahara, ki hechi delihevi natir.

Amre nezil bahade hay bar nash venecheme. amar ribbi yitzchak, asir lan. i hava azil legabbe gavra rabba dachil chattaa, kegon naaman legabbe elisha, nezil avatreh. hasheta deihu azil legabbe rechike alma, rechike orayyta, gaale mikkolla, asir lan leitchazaa kamayyhu. berich rachamana di sheziv lan minnayyhu. vehay bar nash asir leh. amar ribbi yehuda, veha tanenan bakkol mitrappein, chutz meatze ashera vechulei. amar leh, veda avoda zara ihu, vela od, ella deha ketiv (Devarim 18:10) lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh vegomer. azlu learchayyhu.

Azal hahu bar nash lehahi mearta, hu uvereh, share leh bimarta. ad denafak avoy lekatra lachamareh, nafak kitura deeshsha, umacha leh beresha, vekatleh. addehachi al avoy, veashkecheh mit. natal leh velachamareh, veazal leh. veashkach lehu levatar yoma chad, leribbi yitzchak, uleribbi yehuda, veribbi chizkiyya, dahavo azle. bacha kamayyhu, vesach lon ovada. amar ribbi yitzchak, vela zimnin saggiin amena lach, deasir lemehach tamman. berich rachamana, (Daniel 4:34) di chol maavadohi keshot, veorchateh din. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deazlin beorach keshot, bealma den, uvealma deate, vealayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga vegomer.

Amar ribbi elazar, bechol ovadoy debar nash, live leh delihevon kullehu lishma kaddisha. may lishma kaddisha. leadkera befumeh shema kaddisha al kol ma deihu avid, decholla hu lefulechaneh, vela yishre aloy sitra ochora. begin deihu zammin tedira legabbe bene nasha, veyachil leashraa al hahu avidta. veal da, hashsheti o haerev hava isteav, vesharya
1136: Aleh ruach misava. uma behay kach, man defakid milloy lesitra ochora dela itzterich, al achat kamma vechamma. uvegin kach ketiv (Devarim 23:10) venishmarta mikkol davar ra.

Ribbi elazar hava azil lemecheme laavoy (sefer acher lachemavey) vahava immeh ribbi abba. amar ribbi abba nema millin deorayyta venezil. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Bereshit 12:13) imri na achoti at, hay kera kashya. vechi avraham deihu dachil chattaa, rechimu dekudesha berich hu, hava amar hachi al itteteh, begin deyotvin leh. ella avraham, af al gav dehava dachil chattaa, la samich al zechuta dileh, vela baa min kudesha berich hu leappaka zechuteh, ella al zechuta deitteteh, deyirvavch beginah mamona dishar ammin, deha mamona beitteteh zache leh bar nash, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 19:14) bayit vahon nachalat avot umeAdonai ishsha maskalet. man dezache beishsha maskalet, zoche becholla. uchetiv, (Mishlei 31:11) batach bah lev balah veshalal lo yechsar.

Veavraham hava azil beginah, lemechal shelala mishshear ammin, vesamich al zechuta dilah, dela yechlun leanesha leh, ulechayycha bah. uvegine kach la yahiv midi lememar achoti hi. velo od, ella dechama chad malacha azil kamah, veamar leh leavraham, la tiddechal minnah, kudesha berich hu shadar li, leappaka le mamona dishar ammin, ulenatra lah mikkolla. ucheden la dachil avraham meitteteh, ella mineh, dela chama immeh malacha, ella immah. amar ha hi mitnatra, vaana la netirna. uvegine kach amar, imri na achoti at vegomer.

Yitav li, yetivu li mibbae leh, dichtiv vehaya ki yiru otach hamitzrim veamru ishto zot, veal da yetivu li mibbae leh. ella yitav li, da deazil kammach. yitav li behay alma kudesha berich hu bemamona. vechayta nafshi behahu alma biglalech, dela tisti min orcha dikshot, dei azke beginach bemamona behay alma, vetisti ant beorcha, ha mita zemina behahu alma, ella tistamer, ditchi nafshi behahu alma biglalech.

Uvegin dehahu malacha azil kama lenatra lah, ma ketiv. vaynagga Adonai et paro vegomer, al devar saray vadday, dahavat amrat lemalacha mache, vehu mache. veal da la dachil avraham minnah kelum, deha hi mitnatra. uma dedachil, miggarmeh dachil, dela chama immeh netura hachi.
Ta chaze, eser zimnin pekidat sara lemalacha, lemachaa lefaro. uveeser machteshin alke. simana avdat sara livnaha batraa bemitzrayim.

Ribbi abba patach, (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot. zammin kudesha berich hu leachazaa purekana livnoy, keinnun yomin deshalach kudesha berich hu leappaka leyisrael, veachze innun machteshin bemitzrae, vealke lon beginehon deyisrael. ta chaze, ma ben purekana da, lefurekana demitzrayim. purekana demitzrayim hava bechad malka, uvemalchu chada. hacha, bechol malchin dealma, ucheden yityeykkar kudesha berich hu bechol alma, veyindeun kolla shuletanu dekudesha berich hu, vechullehu yilkun bemachteshin illain, al chad teren, begin deyissarvun kullehu beyisrael.

Ucheden yitgele shuletaneh dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz. ucheden kullehu yitnaddevun behu beyisrael lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:20) veheviu et kol achechem vegomer. keden kayymin avahan bechedva, lemecheme purekana divnayyhu kemillekaddemin. hada hu dichtiv, kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot. amen ken yehi ratzon. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen: yimloch Adonai amen veamen:
1137: (Vayikra 14:1-2) vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor. zot tihye torat hammetzora beyom tohorato vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (sifre Shemot 26 amud alef) (Iyov 19:29) guru lachem mippene cherev ki chema avonot charev lemaan tedun shaddun. shaddun, shaddin ketiv. kama it lon livne nasha leistammera archayyhu uledachala mikkamme kudesha berich hu, dela yiste mearcha dechashra, vela yaavor al pitgame orayyta, vela yitneshe minnah.

Dechol man dela lae beorayyta, vela yishtedal ba, nezifa hu mekudesha berich hu, rechika hu minneh, la sharya shechinta immeh. veinnun neturin, deazlin ammeh, istelaku minneh, velo od ella demachreze kameh veamre, istelaku socharaneh diflanya, dela chash al yekara demareh. vavy leh, deha shavkuhu illain vetattain. let leh chulaka bearcha dechayye.

Vechad ihu ishtaddal befulechana demareh, velae beorayyta, kama neturin zeminin lokovleh lenatra leh, ushechinta sharya aleh, vecholla machreze kammeh veamre, havu yekara lediyyukena demalka, havu yekara livreh demalka, itnetir hu bealma den uvealma deate, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, belishana bisha deamar nachash leitteta, garim leitteta, uleadam, lemigzar alayyhu mita, veal kol alma belishana bisha ketiv, (Tehillim 57:5) uleshonam cherev chadda. begin kach, guru lachem mippene cherev, mippene lishana bisha. ki chema avonot charev. may ki chema avonot charev. da cherev laAdonai, ditnan, cherev it leh lekudesha berich hu, deveh dain lechayyayvayya. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:6) cherev laAdonai mala dam. (Devarim 32:42) vecharbi tochal basar. uvegin kach guru lachem mippene cherev ki chema avonot charev lemaan tedun shaddun, shaddin ketiv. begin detedun dehachi ittedan, man deit leh cherev belishaneh, izdeman leh cherev (sefer acher achedan behahu cherev) deshatze kolla, hada hu dichtiv zot tihye torat hammetzora.

Ribbi elazar patach, (Kohelet 9:12) vechatztzipporim haachuzzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam. hay kera ha ittemar. aval ta chaze, bene nasha la yadin, vela shamin, vela mistakkele biruta demarehon, vecharoza kol yoma kare kamayyhu, velet man detzayit leh, velet man deyittear rucheh lefulechana demareh.

Beshaata deramash lelya, vetarin setimin, ittear nukeba dithoma rabba, vechamma chavile terikin mishtakkeche bealma. keden appil kudesha berich hu shenata al kol bene alma, vaafillu al kol di behon ittearuta dechayye, veinnun shatan bealma, umodin lehu livne nasha, millin, minnehon kedivan, uminnehon keshot, uvene nasha itketaru beshenata.

Kad ittear rucha detzafon, veitpelig lelya, shalhova nafka uvatash techot gadpoy detarnegola, vekare, vekudesha berich hu al beginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikayya. ucheden karoza nafik vekare, vechol bene alma mitare bearsayyhu, innun di behon ittearuta dechayye, kayymin lefulechana demarehon, veaske beorayyta uvishvacha dekudesha berich hu ad deate tzafra.

Kad ate tzafra, (sefer acher karoza kare bekol) kol chayyaylin umashiryayn dilella meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vegomer. keden kama tarin itpetachu lechol sitrin. vetara deavraham, itpetach bah bichneset yisrael, lezammena lechol bene alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 21:33) vayyitta eshel biver shava.
Uman dela yittear rucheh befulechana demareh, behech
1138: Anpin yekum kame malka, kad yittearun aleh bedina, veyitpesun leh bekolara, vela yishtekach aleh zechuta leishtezava, keden ketiv, (Kohelet 9:12) vechatztzipporim haachuzot bappach kahem yukashim bene adam. vead la yinpok bar nash mehay alma, bechamma dinin ittedan nafsha im gufa, ad la yitparshun da min da, velet man deyishgach.

(Afillu) behahu zimna demata shaata leitparsha, la nafka nafsha min gufa, ad deitgele aleh shechinta, venafsha, miggo chedvata vachavivuta dishchinta, nafka miggufa lekovlaha. i zakkaa hu, mitkeshar bah veitdabbak bah. vei lav, shechinta azla, vehi ishtearat, veazlat umitabbela al perishuta degufa. matla amre. shunera meeshsha la mitparsha, chadde lesakkina, azla avatreh.

Levatar itdanu tarvavyyhu al yedoy deduma. gufa ittedan bekivra ad detav leafra, venafsha beeshsha degehinnam bechamma dinin, ad hahu zimna deitgezar alah lekabbela onsha. batar dekabbilat onsha, umate zimna leitdakkea, keden istalka miggehinnam, veitlabbenat mechovaha kefarzela deitlabban benura, vesallekin immah, ad dealat leginta deeden diltatta, veistache tamman beinnun mayya, veistache bevusemin detamman. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim) mekutteret mor ulevona. vekayyeyma tamman ad zimna deitgezar aleh leitrachaka meatar deyatvin beh tzaddikayya.

Vechad mata zimna lesalleka, keden sallekin immah, darga batar darga, ad deitkerivat kekurebna al madbecha. hada hu dichtiv, zot tihye torat hammetzora beyom tohorato vehuva el hakkohen, kahana illaa dilella, hay nafsha dela isteavat kol kach, behay alma, hay it lah tekanta, kegavvna da. vei lav, (Kohelet 1:15) meuvvavt lo yuchal litkon vegomer.

(Vayikra 14:2) zot tihye torat hammetzora. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshamesh vegomer. hay kera ittemar, veokimna leh benishmeta debar nash, beshaata dehi kayyeyma immeh debar nash behay alma, keden, vezarach hashshemesh. uva hashshamesh, bezimna denafik bar nash mehay alma, veishtechach bitshuva, keden el mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham, i zakkaa ihu, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 22:7) uva hashshemesh vetaher, veachar yochal min hakkodashim.

Ta chaze, kol chove alma, kudesha berich hu mechapper alayyhu, bitshuva, bar mehahu lishana bisha, deappik shum bish al chavreh. veha ukemuha, dichtiv, zot tihye torat hammetzora, zot hi torato shel motzi shem ra. ribbi chiyyay amar, kol man deappik lishana bisha, istaavan leh kol shayyfoy, veyitchaze lesagra, begin dehahi milla bisha salleka veittear rucha misava aloy veisteav, ate leistaava mesaavin leh, bemilla diltatta ittear milla ochora.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 1:21) echa hayta lezona kirya neemana vegomer. man dahavat mehemana levalah, ahadrat lezona. meleati mishpat, mishpat, vadday da kudesha berich hu, tzedek, da keneset yisrael, uvegin deattearat milla ochora, istellak minnah kudesha berich hu, vesharya bah rucha dekatule. hada hu dichtiv veatta meratzchim. uma yerushalam karta kaddisha kach, shear bene nasha al achat kamma vechamma. hada hu dichtiv, zot tihye torat hammetzora.

Ribbi yehuda amar, zot tihye vadday lokovleh leitpara minneh, dehahu motzi shem ra, beyom tohorato vehuva el hakkohen, may ka mashma lan. mashma, man deit leh lishana bisha tzeloteh la alat kamme kudesha berich hu, deha ittear aleh rucha misava. kevan deahadar bitshuva vekabbil aleh teshuva, ma ketiv, beyom tohorato vehuva el hakkohen vegomer veraa hakkohen vegomer.

(Vayikra 14:4) vetzivva hakkohen velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot. ribbi yitzchak veribbi yose havo shechiche kammeh derabbi shimon. yoma chad amar leh, etz erez ha yedia, kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 Adonai:13) min haerez asher ballevanon, deha hahu etz erez, la ishtarshan netioy ella ballevanon, veha ittemar. ezov lamma, umay hu.
Patach veamar, velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot tehorot veetz erez usheni tolaat
1139: Veezov. ta chaze, bar nash demishtaddel befulechana demareh, veishtedal beorayyta, kudesha berich hu share aloy ushechinta ishtattefa bahadeh. kevan debar nash ate leistaava, shechinta istalakat minneh, kudesha berich hu itrechik minneh, vechol sitra dikdushsha demareh merachakin mineh, veshari aleh ruach misava vechol sitra dimsaava, ate leitdakkea mesayyeyin leh. batar deitdakke veahdar bitshuva, hahu deistallak minneh ahdar, veshari aloy.

Ta chaze, ketiv velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim chayyot tehorot. kevan deamar, shete tzipporim, la yedana deinnun chayot, ella, ha ukemuha, aval chayyot, chayyot mammash. kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:15) vaere hachayyot, lokovel atar deyanke minnayyhu nevie mehemne, veetz erez ha ittemar, usheni tolaat, setar sumaka digvura deishtattef bahadeh bekadmita. veezov, da 6 zeera, deyanik leh likkeneset yisrael, uvegin kach, etz erez veezov, azlan kachada, veal da 6 6 kachada ishtechachu, chad illaa, vechad zeera, vekaryayn lon, 6 illaa, 6 tattaa. vechullehu ahadru lesharya aloy begin deha itdache, lokovel illen, letatta (minnayyhu), etz erez veezov usheni tolaat ishtechachu (bishma) bedachyuta da, vetalyayn meillen illain.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak havo azle bearcha. yatvu behahu be chakla vetzallu. batar desiyymu tzelota kamu veazlu. patach ribbi yehuda bemille deorayyta. veamar, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vetomcheha meushshar. etz chayim, da orayyta, deihi ilana illaa rabba vetakkif. tora, amay ikre tora. begin deore vegalle bema dehava satim dela ityeda. chayim, dechol chayyim dilella bah itkelilu, uminah nafkin. lammachazikim bah, leinnun deachdin bah, deman deachid beorayyta achid becholla, achid leella vetatta. vetomcheha meushshar, man tomcheha. illen innun dematilin melay, lechisan shel talmide chachamim, kema deukemuha.

Vetomcheha, zache linvie mehemne deyippekun minneh. meushshar, al tikre meushshar, ella merosho, innun tamchin leorayyta, merosho vead sofo. merosho, da resha decholla deikre rosh, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:23) meolam nissachti merosh. verosh da chachma, deihi resha lechol gufa, vegufa itpeshat beh ad siyyuma deshit sitrin, vetomcheha, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) shokav ammude shesh. deinnun dematilin melay lechisan shel talmide chachamim innun tamchin leorayyta meresha ad siyyuma degufa, vechol mehemnuta, beh talya, veittemach. vezache livnin deyitchazun linvie mehemne.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Vayikra 1:1) vayikra el moshe vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. vayikra alef zeera, amay. ella begin leachazaa man hu hahu dekara, hahu deshare bemakdesha, ucheden zammin lemoshe, keman dezammin ushepiza. hacha 1 zeera, hatam 1 rabbeta, adam shet enosh. (sefer acher adam) da shelimu decholla.

Ta chaze, ma ben moshe leaharon, he minnayyhu illaa. ella moshe illaa, moshe shushevina demalka, aharon shushevina dematronita. metal lemalka dehava leh matronita illaa. ma avad. yahav lah shushevina letakkena lah uleistakkela bemille deveta. veal da, kad ayyil shushevina da lemalka, la ayyil ella im matronita, hada hu dichtiv, bezot yavo aharon vegomer.

Moshe shushevina lemalka, begin kach izdaman keushepiza, ulevatar, vaydabber Adonai elav. aharon hu shushevina lematronita, vechol milloy havo, lefayyeysa lemalka bematronita, veyitpeyays malka bahadah. veal da begin deihu, shushevina lah shavvi madoreh bahadah, letakkena beta uleayyna tadir bemille deveta. veal da ittekkan kegavvna dilella, veikre kohen gadol. mena lan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:4) atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek.
Uvegin kach kol ma deitzterich mibbe malka, natil, velet man deyimche bideh. veal da hu kaim ledakkea lechol innun dealin leve matronita, begin dela
1140: Yishtekach misava beinnun bene hechala. uvegin kach ketiv, velakach lammittaher shete tzipporim vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 2:4) yoshev bashshamayim yischak Adonai yilag lamo. yoshev bashshamayim yischak, da yitzchak deate missitra dechamra, nahir bekadmita, vechayich, ulevatar zaim vetarich. hada hu dichtiv yoshev bashshamayim vela ketiv, yoshev shamayim. yischak, nahir vechayich. veal da dina nahir vechayich, lehu lerashiayyay.

Ulevatar ma ketiv, az yedabber elemo veappo uvacharono yevahalemo. vechach arche dechayyayvayya, kudesha berich hu nahir lehu behay alma, venahir lon anpin kechamra, denahir bekadmita, ulevatar zaim vekatil. vekudesha berich hu mashich lon lechayyayvayya, i yehadrun lokovleh, yaut, vei la shatze lon mehahu alma deate, velet lon beh chulaka, veyishtetzun mikkolla. attun leitdakkea, mesayyeyin lon. vekudesha berich hu medakke lon vekariv lon legabbeh, vekari alayyhu shalom. hada hu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok velakkarov vegomer.

(Vayikra 16) veishsha ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim belo et niddatah vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Zecharya 14:1) hinne yom ba laAdonai vechullak shelalech bekirbech. hay kera hachi mibbae leh, hinne yom yavo, may, hinne yom ba. ella shekkevar ba, ad la ivre alma, vehu yom deveh yavid dina lechayyayvayya. vehu yom deveh yitpera kudesha berich hu meinnun deakun lon leyisrael. hay yom ba vekaim kame kudesha berich hu, vetava minneh lemebad dina uleshetzaa avodat kochavim umazzalot, veityehiv leh reshu, kema deat amer (Zecharya 14:2) veasafti et kol haggoyim el yerushalam lammilchama vegomer.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, teren yomin innun lekudesha berich hu, chad share immeh, vechad ate lekammeh, uveillen avid kudesha berich hu keravin becholla. vechad hay yoma, ate leaggacha kerava, izdevvavg behahu yoma ochora, venatil zayynin al zayyneh, veagach kerava becholla, beinnun ramin unemuchin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:12) ki yom laAdonai tzevaot, al kol gee varam veal kol nissa veshafel.

Ribbi shimon amar, veishsha ki yazuv zov damah vegomer. hayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:6) cherev laAdonai mala dam. mala dam vadday, dichtiv ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim. belo et niddatah, hayeynu dichtiv, (Daniel 9:14) vayyshkod Adonai al haraa vayvieha alenu. detanenan, kudesha berich hu akdim pureanuta lealma, chayyayvayya mekaddemin pureanuta bechovehon lemete lealma, o chi tazuv al niddatah. hayeynu (Vayikra 26:18) veyasafti leyassera etchem, mahu veyasafti leyassera. osif dina al dina, veetten dama al dama, yattir al ma deit behahu cherev laAdonai mala dam.

Ketiv, (Bereshit 8:21) lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam. mahu lo osif. ella, la etten od tosefet lehahu cherev, ella kegavvna deyachil alma lemisbal. veha ketiv veyasafti. ella leyassera ketiv, vela leshetzaa. hada hu dichtiv, o ki tazuv al niddatah.

Kol yeme zov tumeatah. mahu kol yeme zov tumeatah. ella chayyayvayya mesaavin bechovehon legarmehon, umesaavin laatar ochora, kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 19:20) ki et mikdash Adonai timme. veittear ruach misava alayyhu. ulezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu ledakkea lehu leyisrael uleabera lehahu rucha misava mealma. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:1) lo yosif yavo vach od arel vetame. uchetiv (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz. min haaretz vadday. (man deate leistaava mesaavin leh vadday)

Ribbi chizkiyya hava yativ kammeh deribbi elazar, lelya chad kamu befalgut lelya lemile beorayyta. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Kohelet 7:14) beyom tova heye vetov vegomer gam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim vegomer. beyom tova heye vetov, bezimna deasge kudesha berich hu chesed bealma, bae bar nash lemehach beshuke uleitchazaa kame kolla, deha kad share tivuta dekudesha berich hu bealma, becholla share, uvecholla avid tivu veasge leh bealma. uvegin kach, yitchaze bar nash beitgalya beshuke, veyavid tivu delishre aleh tivu ochora. hada hu dichtiv beyom tova heye vetov. heye vetov vadday.
Uveyom raa ree. la ketiv uveyyom raa heye bera, ella, beyom raa ree. deha beshaata dedina talya bealma, la live leh leeynish leitchazaa beshuka
1141: Ulemehach yechidaa bealma. deha kad dina sharya bealma, al kolla share. uman defaga beh, veara kammeh, yitdan behahu dina. ucheden ketiv, (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat. deha mishpat istallak mitzedek, vela sharyayn da beda al alma. veal da ree. ree vahavi natir, ashgach veayen lechol setar. vahavi yada, divchullehu sharya dina, vela tippuk levar, vela titchaze beshuka, begin dela yishre alach. may tama. begin degam et ze leummat ze asa haelohim. kama dechad share tivu bealma share al kolla, kach, kad sharya dina bealma share al kolla, uman deira beh itpas.

Ta chaze, kad dina sharya bealma, kama sayyfin talyayn, denafke mehahu cherev illaa, vezakfin resha vechaman deha hahu cherev illaa sumaka, malyay dama bechol sitrin, keden gazrin nimusin. vechamma sayyfayya ittearu, (sefer acher keden paseyren sayypeyn, vechamma nimusin ittearu) kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 3:8) ish charbo al yerecho. uchetiv, (Yehoshua Adonai:13) vecharbo shelufa beyado. vechullehu mishtakkeche lemebad dina. uman deyira behu ittezak. ketiv, (Bereshit 19:19) hine na matza avdecha chen beenecha vattagdel chasdecha vegomer. may tama, begin divchol atar dedina sharya becholla sharya, ben bemata ben bemadbera uvesacharana demata.
