Tu patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 8:6) simeni chachotam al libbecha vegomer. simeni chachotam, keneset yisrael amra da lekudesha berich hu. simeni chachotam, man hu chotam. da chotam degushepanka dikshot. chachotam al libbecha, da chotam shel tefillin, deanach bar nash al libbeh. kachotam al zeroecha, da yad keha, demanach behahu zeroa, umanu yitzchak. ukkeneset yisrael kaamar simeni kachotam, chotam mibbae leh, may kachotam. keinnun tefillin deresha, deate shevacha lechol gufa. veal da tefilin bazzeroa, al hallev, uveda ishtechach bar nash shelim kegavvna dilella.

Ki azza chammavt ahava. may ki azza chammavt. ella la ishtechach kashyuta bealma, kema difrishu denafsha miggufa, kad bayayn leitparsha. (veal da) kach ahavat keneset yisrael lekudesha berich hu, dela itparshan lealmin. uvegin kach tefilla shel yad, itkashshera bizroa, lekayyeyma dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi.

Kasha chishol kina. bechol dargin degehinnam, la it kashya kishol, denachit letatta minnayyhu, bar hahu darga deikre avaddon, veda veda ishtattafu kachada. veda kashya lehu lechayyayvayya mikkolla. kach, kasha chishol kina, delet kina ella birchimuta, umiggo rechimuta ate kina, uman dekanne lehahu derachim (vaychi 175 amud alef) yattir, kashya leh leitparsha minneh mehahu darga deikre sheol, deihu kashya mikkol dargin degehinnam.

Reshafeha rishfe esh shalhevet yah. uman ihu shalhevet yah, da eshsha denafik miggo shofar, kalil merucha umaya. umiggo hahu shalhova kad mitlahata bikkeneset yisrael, okid alma beshalhovuta bekina dekudesha berich hu, uveshaata dehi mekannea leh, vavy deara beshalhovita, deihu yittokad behu.

Tu patach veamar. (Shir HaShirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot vegomer. mayim rabbim da deroa yemina, devae lekashshera beh kishra ditfilla al deroa semala, lekayyeyma vimino techabbekeni. davar acher, mayim rabbim, da hu nahar illaa, deminneh nafkin naharin lechol ivar, vechullehu nagdin veitmashshechan minneh. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 93:4) mikkolot mayim rabbim. meinnun kolot demayim rabbim, denafkan veitmashshechan minneh. uneharot, kema deat amer, nasu neharot vegomer.

Im yitten ish et kol hon beto baahava, derachim keneset yisrael lekudesha berich hu, yavuzu lo. (Shir HaShirim 8:7) boz yavuzu lo, yavuz mibbae leh, may yavuzu lo. ella, im yitten ish, da kudesha berich hu. et kol hon beto, kema deat amer (Mishlei 24:4) kol hon yakar venaim. beahava, dekneset yisrael legabbeh, vela leitkashshera bahadah, boz yavuzu lo, kol innun
1142: Uchelusin vechol innun mashiryayn dilella, lehahu hon yakar, deha let reuta lechullehu ella beshaata dekneset yisrael mitkashshera beh bekudesha berich hu, umitattera bahadeh, keden kol innun uchelusin, vechol innun mashiryayn, vechullehu almin kullehu bechedu, binhiru, bevirkan, (al da amar) ketiv semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. man deanach tefillin, kad manach tefilla shel yad, bae leoshata deroa semala, lekabbela lah likkeneset yisrael, ulekashshera kishra im yemina, begin lechabbeka lah, lekayyeyma dichtiv, semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. leitchazaa bar nash kegavvna dilella, uleitattera becholla, ucheden bar nash shelim becholla, bikdushsha illaa. vekudesha berich hu kare aleh, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Tosefta boz yavuzu lo. may boz. yoma tinyayna veyoma shetitaa veyoma sheviaa desukkot, divhon havo menasseche mayim veyayin. dez yomin desukkot, behon havo makrivin yisrael, 70 parim, lechappera al shivin memanan, begin dela yishtear alma charuv minnayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 29:12) uvachamishsha asar yom vegomer vehikravtem ola ishshe vegomer. (ad kan tosefta)

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (tehillim 17) shima Adonai tzedek vegomer. kama chaviva keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, divchol zimna dekneset yisrael, atat lekammeh dekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu izdeman lokovlah. hada hu dichtiv shima Adonai tzedek hakeshiva rinnati haazina tefillati. amar david, ana itkattarna bikkeneset yisrael. kema dehi ishtechachat lekammach, ana name hachi ishtechachna. uvegin kach shima Adonai tzedek, bekadmita, ulevatar, hakeshiva rinnati haazina tefillati.

Belo sifte mirma. may bela sifte mirma. ella hachi tanenan. kol milla umilla ditzlota, deappik bar nash mippumeh, salka leella uvaka rekiin, vealat laatar dealat, tamman itbechanat hahi milla, i hi milla dechashra i la, i ihi milla dechashra alin lah kame malka kaddisha lemebad reutah. vei lav, satin lah levar, veitar behahi milla rucha ochora.

Veta chaze, ketiv beh beyosef, (Tehillim 105:19) innu vakkevel raglo vegomer. ad ematay, innu vakkevel raglo. ad et bo devaro imrat Adonai tzerafathu. ad et bo devaro deman. ella ad et bo devaro (deyosef, vaatabechayn) hahi milla, hada hu dichtiv, imrat Adonai tzerafathu. keden, shallach melech vayyattirehu moshel ammim vayfattechehu. addehachi hava ata tzafra.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim. nefesh adoni, setam. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 24:4) asher lo nasa lashav nafshi, ha idana betzafra leitkashshera keneset yisrael uleitchabbera bevalah, zakkain innun tzaddikayya demishtaddelin beorayyta belelya, veatan leitkashshera beh bekudesha berich hu ubbikkeneset yisrael. alayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimecha vetagel yoladtecha.

Amar ribbi elazar ketiv, (Vayikra 15:31) vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumeatam vegomer betammeam et mishkani asher betocham. vehizzartem, kehay zar, deihu zar mekullehu, vela itchabbar bema deleteh dileh.

Veta chaze, beshaata demistaavin bene nasha letatta, misavin lon becholla, veha ittemar. aval, beshaata deruach misava ittear (sefer acher letatta, ittear ruach vechulei) chashavtun zar, ella ruach misava diltatta, ittear ruach misava ochora, veityehiv leh reshuta lenachta lealma. may reshuta, reshuta dikdushsha dehava nachit umache beh, la ishtechach, veistellak, ucheden itgalyay dina, lokovlehon dechayyayvin, veosif dina al dineh, ucheden, teren ruchin mishtakkechin bealma, chad, rucha dedina, vechad, rucha dimsaava.

Amar ribbi elazar, itzterichna hacha lememar milla deolifna meabba. ta chaze, hacha yalfinan minnega deveta. dechad rucha misava sharya beveta vekudesha berich hu bae ledakkea leh, shadar nega tzaraat beveta, lekatrega da beda, vehahu nega la ade mibbeta, veaf al gav deruach misava istellak mehahu beta, ad deyintetzun beta, avanin veain vecholla, keden itdache atra.

Kehay gavvna, man deisteav veittear rucha misava veshari aloy, kad bae kudesha berich hu ledakkea alma, ittear ruach dina takkifa, veishtechach bealma vesharya al hahu rucha misava, umekatrege da beda, ad
1143: Deyitabbar mealma, vehahu rucha dina takkifa, la istellak meatreh ad deyinnatetz atar, shayyfin vegarmin vecholla, keden itdache alma veitabberu minneh ruchin misavin, vealma ishtechach bedachyu.

Veal da tanenan, ata leistaava misavin leh vday. vavy leh lebar nash kad share aleh ruach misava, veishtechach beh bealma, devadday linda, dekudesha berich hu bae levaara leh min alma. zakkain innun tzaddikayya dechullehu kaddishin, veishtechachu bikdushsha kame malka kadisha, vesharya alayyhu ruach kaddisha, behay alma uvealma deate. kevan deata tzafra kamu azlu.

Ad dahavo azle, patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Bereshit 32:2-3) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. veyaakov halach ledarko, dehava azil lokovel avuhi. ta chaze, kol zimna, deyaakov ishtechach legabbeh delavan la mallil immeh kudesha berich hu, (velo ishtechach legabbeh) vei tema, veha ketiv, (Bereshit 31:3) vayyomer Adonai el yaakov shuv el eretz avotecha ulemoladtecha vegomer. hay besofa hava, bezimna devaa leitparsha millavan vechad itperash minneh, atu lokovleh innun malache veozfuhu beorcha.

Ta chaze, ketiv, vayyifgeu vo. vayyifga bemalache elohim mibbae leh, may vo. ella inhu atu leitkallela beh (veozfuhu beorcha). may leitkallela beh. ella innun missitra digvura kaatyayn, dichtiv malache elohim, vechama missitra ochora malache derachame, veitkallu beh rachame vedina.

Ta chaze, bekadmita, machane elohim, ze chad. levatar vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim, tere. chad missitra dedina vechad missitra derachame, malachin mehay gisa, umalachin mehay gisa, veal da ketiv, vayyifgeu vo. vo, dayyka. vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam, raa otam mibbae leh, may raam. ella chama lon kelilan kachada, mitdabbekan da beda, mitchabberan da beda, veal da ketiv raam, vechullehu atu leozfa leh uleshezava leh mida deesav.

Ketiv beh beesav, (Bereshit 25:25) vayetze harishon admoni. vayyetze harishon, i tema, deyaakov tippa kadmaa hava, lav hache, deha ketiv, vayyetze harishon, vela ketiv, vayyetze rishon. uvegin deyitzchak ate missitra dedina kashya, nafak esav admoni, sumaka. dei yaakov hava buchera, hahi tippa kadmaa nafka hachi sumaka. aval tippa tinyayna hava, uvegin kach la nafka hache, deha missitra derachame havat hahi tippa, mehay gisa umehay gisa.
Vetippa deesav la havat ketippa deyaakov, deda shelim veda la shelim. uvehahi shaata, yitzchak hava
1144: Mechavvivn besiuma dedina kashya, deappik besitroy, biglifoy tehirin beshayyfoy, uvegin kach esav, zuhama deithattich middahava.

Veal da tanenan, devae bar nash lechavvevna behahi shaata, biruta demareh, begin deyippuk benin kaddishin lealma. vei tema, yitzchak la itkavvavn. lav hache, ella itkavvavn bikdushsha, veitkavvavn besiuma dehahu atar, veishtechach kad nafak hahi tippa kadmaa, behahu atar mammash, veal da ketiv, kullo keadderet sear.

Ta chaze, david bishfiru desumaka nafak, veitachad bikdushsha demareh. veal da ketiv, (Shmuel 1 16:12) vehu admoni im yefe enayim vetov roi. aval yaakov buchera hava minneh deesav, lav mittippa, ella dechavvavna diruta, beilana illaa ravreva vetakkif, veesav behahu atar desiuma decholla, uvegin kach ketiv, (Ovadya 1:2) hinne katon netatticha baggoyim bazuy atta meod.

Ribbi yehuda hava matne hache. esav nikra rishon, dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:25) vayyetze harishon admoni kullo. vekudesha berich hu ikre rishon, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 44:6) ani rishon vani acharon veet acharonim ani hu. vezammin leitpara rishon merishon. ulemivne rishon, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:12) kisse chavod marom merishon. ulezimna deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 41:27) rishon letziyyon hinne hinnam veliyrushala 40 mevasser etten.

Tana, zemina yerushalam, lemehevi shuraha leella uleitkarva ad kurese yekara demalka. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 3:17) baet hahi yikreu liyrushala 40 kisse Adonai. keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim. keden (Zecharya 14:9) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen: yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1145: Tosefta (58 45) ribbi elazar, veribbi yose chamuy, havo azle meusha lelud. amar ribbi yose leribbi elazar, efshar shamat meavuch may dichtiv, veyaakov halach ledarko vegomer. amar leh la yedana. ad dahavo azle matu limarta delud. shamu hahu kala deamar, tere uzelin deayalta avdu kamay reuta denicha li. veinnun havo mashiryyayta kaddisha deara yaakov kammeh. itregish ribbi elazar, veistaar benafshoy, veamar, mareh dealma kach orchoy, tav lan dela nishma, shemana vela yedana.

Itrechish leh nisa, veshama hahu kala deamar, avraham veyitztzechak havo, nafal al anpoy vechama diyyukena daavoy, amar leh, abba, shailna vaativuna, deavraham veyitztzechak havo, dearu leyaakov kad ishteziv millavan. amar leh beri, puk (sefer acher pasekach) pitkach, vesav sevatech, pum memallel ravrevan hava. vela da hi bilchodoy, ella lechol tzaddikayya nishmathon detztzaddikayya mearin kodamohi leshezavuteh, veinnun malache kadishe illae.

Veta chaze, yitztzechak kayyaym hava behahi shaata, aval nishmateh kaddisha itnesivat bechuresya yekara demareh, kad itakad al gabbe madbecha. umikkeden astemu enoy mechezu. hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:42) lule vegomer ufachad yitztzechak haya li. (ad kan tosefta)

Raza demilla hu, ivdu et Adonai beyira, ma yira hacha. ella kema deokimna, dichtiv, (Mishlei 1:7) yirat Adonai reshit daat, uchetiv, (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai. yirat Adonai, kudesha berich hu hachi ikre. ribbi elazar amar, ivdu et Adonai beyira, man devae lemebad pulechana demareh, mean atar share, uvean atar yechavvivn pulechana leyachada shema demareh. hadar veamar beyira, beyira hu sheruta, mittatta leella. (401 chaze bene aharon hay okimna veha ittemar milla)
Ta chaze, ma ketiv hacha achare mot, ulevatar dabber el aharon achich vegomer bezot yavo aharon, ella mikkan, sheruta leazhara lechahane, kol man, devayayn leizdahara behay zot, veda hi yirat Adonai.

Davar acher. achare mot shene bene aharon. ribbi yose amar, achare mot nadav vaavihu, mibbae leh, may tama shene bene aharon, veha yedia divnoy havo. ella hachi tana, dead kan lav birshutayyhu kayyme, ella birshuta deavuhon, uvegin kach, bekarvatam lifne Adonai vayamutu, deinnun dachaku shaata bechayye deavuhon, vecholla hava, begin hahu chova deavdu, dichtiv (Bamidbar 3:4) behakerivam esh zara. detanya, beatar chad, ketiv behakerivam esh zara, uveatar chad ketiv, bekarvatam lifne Adonai. vehay vehay hava, uvegin kach ketiv hacha bene aharon, uchetiv bekarvatam.

(Tana) amar ribbi chiyay, yoma chad havina azil bearcha, lemehach gabbe deribbi shimon, lemelaf minneh parsheta defischa. arit bechad tura, vachamena bekiin gummin bechad tinra, uteren guverin va. ad dahavina azil, shemana kala deinnun guverin, vahavu amrin, (Tehillim 48:1-2) shir mizmor livne korach gadol Adonai umehulal meod vegomer. may shir mizmor. ella hachi tana mishshemeh doribbi shimon, shir deihu kaful, shir deihu meshubbach mishshear shirin, veal deihu meshubbach mishshear shirin, teren zimnin ittemar beh shirata, vechen (Tehillim 92:1) mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat. kehay gavvna, (Shir HaShirim 1:1) shir hashshirim asher lishlomo, shirata leella min shirata.

Shir mizmor, shirata dekudesha berich hu, deka mezammere bene korach al innun deyatve, al pitcha degehinam. uman innun, achuhon deinnun deyatve betare degehinnam. veal da, shirata da beyom sheni ittemar. karivna gabbayyhu, amena lehu, may asakayychu baatar da. amru mezabbene anan, utere yome beshabbeta, badilna miyishuva venaasek beorayyta. begin dela shavkin lan bene nasha, kol yoma veyoma. amena zakkaa chulakechon.

Tu patchu veamru. bechol zimna detzadikaya mistalleke mealma, dina istallak mealma, umitathon detzadikaya mechapperet al chove dara. veal da parsheta divne aharon, beyoma dechippure karenan lah, lemehevi kappara lechovehon deyisrael. amar kudesha berich hu, itasseku bemitathon detzaddikayya illen, veyitchashev lechu keillu attun mekarvin karbenin behay yoma lechappera alayychu. detanenan, kol zimna deyisrael yehon begaluta, vela yikrevun karbenin behay yoma, veinnun teren seirin la yachlin lekarva, yehe lehu duchrana, ditre bene aharon, veyitkapper alayyhu.

Dehachi olifna, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 3:2) veelle shemot bene aharon hakkohanim vegomer. uchetiv, habbechor nadav vaavihu elazar veitamar. veelazar veitamar mibbae leh, mahu elazar veitamar. ella shakul hava avihu kitre achuy. venadav kechullehu.

Veit dematne (la ippecha) habbechor nadav, da bilchodoy, vaavihu bilchodoy, vechol chad itchashiv beeneh, ketarvayyhu, keelazar veitamar. aval nadav vaavihu bilchodayyhu, shekulin havo lekavel shivin sanhedrin, dahavo meshammeshin kame moshe. uvegin kach, mitathon mechappera al yisrael. veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 10:6) vaachechem kol bet yisrael yivku et hasserefa. veamar ribbi shimon, habbechor nadav, kelomar, hahu, dechol shevacha vikara dilleh (45 shemeh). nadav vaavihu, al achat kamma vechamma, dehane tere, la ishtechachu kevatayyhu beyisrael.
Vaydabber Adonai el moshe achare mot shene bene aharon. ribbi
1146: Chizkiyya patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 29:22) lachen ko amar Adonai el bet yaakov asher fada et avraham vegomer. hay kera kashya, lachen ko amar Adonai asher fada et avraham mibbae leh. may, ko amar Adonai el bet yaakov asher fada et avraham.

Ella ha ukemuha veha ittemar, deyaakov fada et avraham vadday. divhahi shaata denafal bego nura dechasdae, danu dineh (70 veamro kamme kudesha berich hu, begin may yishteziv hay, zechut avahan let leh. amar leh, yishteziv begin benoy, dehachi tanya, bara mezakke abba). amru, ha yishmael denafik minneh. amar kudesha berich hu, ha yitzchak, deyoshit kedaleh al gabbe madbecha. amru, ha esav denafik minneh. amar, ha yaakov, deihu kuresya shelemata, vechol benohi shelemin kamay. amru, ha vadday bizchuta da yishteziv avraham hada hu dichtiv, asher fada et avraham.

Lo atta yevosh yaakov velo atta panav yechovaru ki viroto yeladav maase yaday bekirbo yakdishu shemi. man innun yeladav maase vegomer. illen innun, chananya mishael vaazarya. daappilu garmayyhu lego nura yakidta lekadasha shemeh lo atta yevosh yaakov may bae hacha yaakov, veha ketiv, (Daniel 1:6) vayhi vahem mibbene yehuda daniel chananya mishael vaazarya. bene yehuda ikrun, uvegin kach lo atta yevosh yehuda mibbae leh, may lo atta yevosh yaakov.

Ella hachi tanenan. behay shaata deittechfitu, leminpal benura, kol chad arim kaleh veamar, gabbe kol innun ammin umalchin veafarchaya, chananya amar, (Tehillim 118:6-7) Adonai li lo ira ma yaase li adam Adonai li beozray vaani ere beshonay tov lachasot baAdonai vegomer. mishael patach veamar, (Yirmeyahu 30:10) veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai vegomer ki ittecha ani neum Adonai lehoshiecha ki eese vegomer. behahi shaata, deshamu kullehu shema deyaakov. tavvhu vechayychu beletzanuta. azarya patach veamar, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 44:5) ze yomar laAdonai ani vegomer. ze yomar laAdonai ani, da chananya, veze yikra veshem yaakov, da mishael, veze yichtov yado laAdonai uveshem yisrael yechanne, da azarya, beh shaata kanash kudesha berich hu pamalya dileh, amar lon, beman milla, meinnun millin deamru illen telata, ashziv lon. patchu veamru, (Tehillim 83:19) veyedu ki atta shimcha Adonai levaddecha elyon al kol haaretz.

Ba shaata amar kudesha berich hu lechuresyay, kuresyay dili, beman milla meinnun millin, ashziv leinnun tzaddikayyay. amar leh, behay milla dechullehu chayyeychin va, ashziv lon, lo atta yevosh yaakov velo atta panav yechovaru. kema dekaim yaakov legabbe deavraham benura, yekum hasheta legabbe illen, hada hu dichtiv, ko amar Adonai el bet yaakov asher fada et avraham lo atta yevosh yaakov vegomer. mehay kissufa deletzanuta.

Tana, kullehu dahavo chayychin mimmilla da, ittokadu behahu nura, vekatal lon sheviva denura. man sheziv leillen. al dahavo metzalan kame kudesha berich hu umeyachadan shemeh kedka yeot, veal dimyachadan shemeh kedka yeot, ishtezivu mehahu nura yakidta.

Tere bene aharon kerivu eshsha nucheraa, dela ityachadu shemeh kedka yeot, veittukadu benura. ribbi yitzchak amar, ketiv, achare mot. uchetiv vayamutu. kevan deamar achare mot shene bene aharon, la yedana, deha vayamutu. ella hachi tanenan, tere mitot havo, chad lifne Adonai. vechad, dela havo lehu benin, dechol man dela zache livnin mit hu. begin kach, achare mot, vayamutu.

Ribbi abba amar, may dichtiv, (Bamidbar 3:4) vayyamat nadav vaavihu lifne Adonai behakerivam esh zara lifne Adonai bemidbar sinay uvanim lo hayu lahem vaychahen elazar veitamar. may da legabbe da, dichtiv, uvanim lo hayu lahem, vaychahen elazar veitamar. ella raza demilta. hay daamena, vayamutu, dela havo lehu benin. vehachi hu vadday. aval la kishar bene alma, af al gav dela ansivu, deha illen la mitu ella mitat garmehon, aval mitat nafshahon la mitu.
Mena lan, dichtiv, (Shemot 6:25) veelazar ben aharon
1147: Lakach lo mibbenot putiel lo leishsha vatteled lo et pinchas elle rashe avot haleviyyim lemishpechotam. elle, veha pinchas bilchodoy hava. uchetiv, rashe avot haleviyyim, begin kach, mitat garmehon mitu, mitat nafshahon la mitu. amar ribbi elazar vadday mashma elle, umashma rashe.

Uvegin kach ketiv, (Bamidbar 25:7) pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen uchetiv ufinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen haya kohen bayamim hahem, pinchas ben elazar hakkohen mibbae leh, ella bechol atar deata pinchas ben aharon hakkohen ketiv, veelazar la ketiv ella elazar hakkohen. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 27:2) velifne elazar hakkohen. (Bamidbar 31:21) vayyomer elazar hakkohen vegomer. veal da mitat garmehon mitu, mitat nafshahon la mitu.
Vetanenan beraza dematnitin, tere zug, pen chas. veha ittemar, yod zeera bene atvavn definchas. dehay yod kalil tere kachada, veda hu raza demilla, veha ittemar.

Ribbi elazar shail laavuy, amar leh, veha tere innun utere havo, amay la ishtechachu tere. amar leh, tere palge gufa havo, deha la ansivu, uvegin kach, bechad itkelilu, dichtiv, vatteled lo et pinchas elle rashe vegomer.

Veyod definchas, la ityeyhiv beh lechabbera atvavn, ella beshaata dekanne lekudesha berich hu, veata leyashshera akima, dechama dehay at berit kaddisha, ayel zimri birshuta ochora. uvemma deitakkam bekadmita, ittakan hacha. benucheraa itakkam bekadmita, dichtiv, behakerivam esh zara, hacha benucheraa, ittakan, kema dichtiv, (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar. ma lehallan esh zara, af kan name isha zara.

May itchaze hacha. ella bekadmita rechika kerivu, dichtiv, behakerivam esh zara. uf hacha zimri, hava kariv rechika, shema demalka, hava kariv gabbe rechika, miyyad, (Bamidbar 25:7) vayar pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen vayyakam mittoch haeda. hacha atkin akima dekadmeta, keden ityeyhiv yod bishmeh lechabbera atvavn kachada, veitbesar beshalom, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 25:12) lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. (beriti mammash).

(58 66 Amud bet) may shalom hacha, ella behahu kitra, chavu bekadmita, behahu kitra, attearu ketatuta bekadmita, vehasheta deittekan, ketiv hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. beriti mammash, tehe immeh beshalom, uvegin kach, ityeyhiv yod zeera bishmeh, deha meatvavn zeiran hi, leatchazaa deha ittakkan ma deitakkam bekadmita, veha ashlimat immeh. ata ribbi elazar venashik yedoy. amar, berich rachamana deshailna hay milla, vela itavid minnay.

Tana amar ribbi yose, behay yoma dechippure, ittekkan lemikre parsheta da, lechappera leyisrael begaluta, begin da, sidra deyoma da, hacha itsaddar, uvegin demitathon divne aharon, mechappera al yisrael.

Mikkan olifna, kol hahu bar nash deyissure demareh atyayn aleh, kappara dechovoy innun. vechol man demitztaar al yissurehon detzaddikayya, maavirin chovayyay dilhon mealma. veal da beyoma da, korin, achare mot shene bene aharon, deyishmeun amma, veyitztaarun al avudehon detzaddikayya, veyitkapper lehon chovayyhu. vechol demitztaar al avudehon detzaddikayya, o achit dimin alayyhu, kudesha berich hu machriz aleh veomer, (Yeshayahu 6:7) vesar avonecha vechattatcha techuppar. velo od, ella dela yemutun benoy beyomoy. vealeh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 53:10) yire zera yaaricha yamim vegomer.

(Vayikra 16:2) vayyomer Adonai el moshe dabber el aharon achicha veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh vegomer rabbi shimon patach veamar, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam enennu male vegomer. amar ribbi shimon, tavvavhna al bene alma, deha let lehu ayynin lemecheze, velibba leashgecha, vela yadin, vela shavyayn libbayyhu leistakkela biruta demaarehon, hech nayymin, vela mitare mishenatayyhu, ad la yete hahu yoma dechafe alayyhu chashocha vekavla, veyitba hahu
1148: Vecharoza kol yoma kare alayyhu, venishmatehon, ashidat behon bechol yoma velelya, orayyta ramat kalin lechol ivar, machrezet veomeret, (Mishlei 1:22) ad matay petaim teehavu feti (Mishlei 9:Adonai) mi feti yasur henna chasar lev amra lo. lechu lachamu velachmi ushetu beyayin masachti. velet man deyarkin udeneh, velet man deyittear libbeh.

Ta chaze, zeminin dare batrae deyetun, deyitneshe orayyta mibbenayyhu, vechakkime libba yitkanneshun leatrayyhu, (sefer acher leatra kaddisha) vela yishtekach man desagir ufatach. vavy lehahu dara. umikkan ulehala, la yehe dara kedara da, ad dara deyete malka meshicha, umandea yittear bealma, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:34) ki chullam yedu oti lemikketannam vead gedolam.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. vetanenan, ma shemeh dehahu nahar. okimna yuval shemeh, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) veal yuval yeshallach sharashav. uvesifra derav hamenuna sava, chayyim shemeh, dimittamman nafkin chayyim lealma, veinnun ikrun chayye malka. veha okimna, hahu ilana rabba vetakkifa, demazon lecholla beh. ikre etz chayyim. ilana denata sharshoy beinnun chayyim, vecholla hu shappir.

Vetana, hahu nahar appik nachalin amikin, bimshach revut, leashkaa ginta, uleravvava ilanin unetiin, dichtiv (Tehillim 104:16) yisbeu atze Adonai arze levanon asher nata, veinnun nachalin, nagdin veitmashshechan umitkanneshin bitren kayaymin (nusach acher samchin) veinnun biryayte (tere) karenan lehu, (Melachim 1 7) yachin uvoaz, veshappir. umittamman nafkin kol innun nachalin, vesharyayn lon bechad darga deikre tzaddik, dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzadik yesod olam. vechullehu azlin umitkanneshin lehahu atar deikre yam, vehu yamma dechachmeta, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 1:7) kol (Shemot 50 amud bet) hannechalim holchim el hayyam vegomer.

Vei tema, deha matu laatar da, ufaskin, vela tayyvin, levatar ketiv, el mekom shehannechalim holchim sham hem shavim lalachet, begin dehahu nahara la pasik lealmin. hem shavim, lean atar shavim, leinnun teren kayymin, netzach vehod. lalachet, behay tzaddik, leashkecha birchaan vechidu. vehayeynu raza detanenan, (Tehillim 104:26) livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo, da tzaddik.

Kullam elecha yesabberun latet achlam beitto. man itto. da (itto detzaddik) matronita, deikre itto detzaddik, uvegin kach kullehu mechakkan lehay itto, kullehu deatteznan letatta, meatar da atteznan, veraza da okimna, (Tehillim 145:15) ene chol elecha yesabberu vegomer kema deokimna.

Ta chaze, beshaata dehay kol, mevassem leitto, umitchabbera immeh, kullehu almin bechedu, kullehu almin bevirkan, keden shelama ishtechach beillae vetattae. vechad garmin chayyayve alma, detaman la ishtechachu birchan deinnun nachale, veyanka, hay et, missitra ochora, keden dinin mitarin bealma, ushelama la ishtechach. vechad baan bene alma leitbarcha, la yachlin ella al yeda dechahana, begin deyittear kitra dileh, veyitberach matronita, veyishtechachu birchan bechullehu almin.

Tana, behahi shaata, baa moshe kame kudesha berich hu, milla da, amar leh, i bene alma yetuvun kammach, al yede deman mitbarchan. amar leh kudesha berich hu, veli at omer, dabber el aharon achicha, deha bideh mesiran birchan leella vetatta.

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe dabber el aharon achicha veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh vegomer. amar ribbi abba, zimnin it kame kudesha berich hu, leishtakkecha raavavn, uleishtachcha birchan, ulemitba baute, vezimnin, deraavavn la ishtechachu, uvirkan la mizdamnan, vedinin kashyayn mitarin bealma. vezimnin dedina tale. ta chaze, zimnin it beshatta, deraavav ishtechach. vezimnin it beshatta, dedina ishtechach. vezimnin it beshatta, dedina ishtechach vetalya. zimnin it beyarche, deraava
1149: Ishtechach behu. vezimnin it beyarche, dedinin ishtechachu, vetalyayn al kolla.

Zimnin it beshavue, deraavavn mishtakkechan, vezimnin it beshavue, dedinin mishtakkechan bealma. vezimnin it beyome, deraavav ishtechach bealma vealma itbasma. vezimnin it beyome dedinin talyayn umishtachchan, vaafillu beshate. veal da ketiv, (Kohelet 3:1) veet lechol chafetz vegomer. uchetiv, (Tehillim 69:14) vaani tefillati lecha vegomer. uchetiv, (yeshaya noah) dirshu Adonai behimmatzo. uchetiv, (Tehillim 10:1) lamma Adonai taamod berachok talim leittot batztzara. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li. vezimnin deihu karov, dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:18) karov Adonai lechol korav. begin kach, veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh vegomer.

Ribbi shimon amar, ha okimna. milla beitto, vehachi hu vday, vehacha ata kudesha berich hu leazhara leaharon, dela yite behahu chova, detau benoy, deha hay et yedia, begin kach la yite lechabbera et ochora, legabbe malka. hada hu dichtiv, veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh. kelomar, af al gav deyecheme iddan, deittemsar bida ochora, leitnahaga alma, veyitmesar bidoy leyayched beh lekarva leh lekudesha, deha ana ushemi chad hu. uvegine kach, (sefer acher lekarva leh lekudesha berich hu deha hay et yedia, begin kach) veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh. vei bae leminda bema yeul. bezot. bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. dehay zot, hi et daachidat bishmi, behay 10, dirshima bishmi, yeul el hakkodesh. (aval) veal yavo vechol et.

Tana amar ribbi yose ketiv (Kohelet 3:11) et hakkol asa yafe veitto hay milla okmah butzina (sefer acher bishma) kaddisha vehachi hu detannina et hakkol asa yafe veitto vehachi hu vadday. et hakkol vadday. asa yafe veitto, da beda, vela yitarvun ochoranin benayyhu. veitto mammash, vela boochara. begine kach, azharuta leaharon, veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh. aval bema yeul. bezot, kema deokimna, dichtiv bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ kame avuha, amar leh, ketiv bichnishta dekorach, (Bamidbar 16:33) veyyovdu mittoch hakkahal, may veyyovdu. ella kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 23:30) vehaavadti et hannefesh hahi mikkerev ammah. (sefer acher ketiv bivne aharon 2 vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam veyamutu. uchetiv bakenayshatea dekorach veesh yatza meet Adonai vattochal et hachamishshim umatayim ish 64 dashekaylayn da keda) amar ribbi shimon, shane innun bene aharon, dela ketiv behu aveda, keinnun dichnishta dekorach, dichtiv behu, veyyovdu mittoch hakkahal. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 17:27) hen gavanu avadnu kullanu avadnu. leachlela innun deakrivu ketoret busemin, matan vechamshin, deitavidu vadday, veillen la itavidu.

Amar leh ketiv, veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh. uchetiv, bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. kevan deamar, veal yavo vechol et, amay la ketiv, bema zimna yeul. amar leh elazar, ha ittemar, umilla chad hu, vezimna chad hu havo yade kahane. aval al ma dechavu benoy, baa leazhara hacha, veha ittemar. amar leh, vaana hachi savirna, uvegin leityayshsheva milla beena.

Amar leh, elazar beri ta chaze, kol karbenin vechol illavavn, nayycha hu dekudesha berich hu, aval la hava nayycha, kema dehay ketoret, diktoret mealya mikkolla. uvegin kach, havo maalin leh lego bego, bilchishu. veha ittemar. uvegin kach, la itanashu kol bene nasa bishar karbenin veillavavn kemo bakketoret, dechol pulechana dekudesha berich hu, hacha itketar veitkeshar yattir mikkolla. veal da ikre ketoret. veha ittemar, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev.

Patach ribbi shimon vedarash, (Shir HaShirim 1:3) lereach shemanecha tovim vegomer. hay kera istakkalna beh, vehachi hu. lereach, may reach. reach diktoret deihu dekika umaalya ufenimaa mikkolla, vechad salik hahu reach leitkashshera, behahu meshach revut denachale mabbua, ittearu da beda veitketaru kachada. ucheden innun mishchan tavan leanhara. kema deat amer, lereach shemanecha tovim.

Ucheden itrak mishcha middarga ledarga, beinnun dargin deikrun shema kaddisha, hada hu dichtiv, shemen turak shemecha al ken alamot ahevucha. may alamot. kema deokimna olamot, olamot mammash, davar acher al ken alamot ahevucha. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 46:1) al alamot shir. vecholla chad.
Uvesifra derav hamenuna sava ketiv, may olamot. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 31:15) vattitten teref levetah vechok
1150: Lenaaroteha. naaroteha hane alamot, ahevucha, levarcha shemach, ulezammera kammach, umittamman ishtakkechan birchan bechullehu tattae, umitbarchin illain vetattain.

Davar acher al ken alamot ahevucha. shappir hu man deamar. al mavt ahevucha, deha bemilla da marehon dedinin itbasseman, uvegin dehay ketoret, itketar bemishcha dilella yattir, itchashav kameh dekudesha berich hu, mikkol karbenin veillavavn. amra keneset yisrael, ana kiktoret, veant kemishcha, mashcheni acharecha narutza vegomer. narutza: kema deat amer, al ken alamot ahevucha. ana vechol uchelusin, deha kullehu bi achidan, veal da mashcheni, deha bi talyayn.

Heviani hammelech chadarav. im yeul li malka beidaroy, nagila venismecha bach, ana vechullehu uchelusin. tana. kullehu uchelusin, beshaata dichneset yisrael chaddat umitbarcha, kullehu chaddan, vedina la sharya keden bealma. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 96:11) yismechu hashshamayim vetagel haaretz.

Ki beanan erae al hakkapporet. amar ribbi yehuda, zakkain innun tzaddikayya, dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon. vetanena, melech vasar vadam, i bar nash rachiv al suseya dileh, bar katala hu, kudesha berich hu arkiv eliyyahu al dileh, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashamayim vegomer. hacha may ketiv, velo yamut ki beanan erae al hakkapporet. vekudesha berich hu ayyleh lemoshe beh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan, betoch heanan mammash, ki beanan erae al hakkapporet. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:Adonai) uvara Adonai al kol mechon har tziyyon veal mikraeha anan yomam veashan. uchetiv, (Shemot 40:38) ki anan Adonai al hammishkan yomam.

Vetana, hay dichtiv, (Shemot 34) vayyered Adonai beanan. beanan erae al hakkapporet. tana, atar dahavo sharan innun keruve, kema deokimna, keruvim al at havo yatvin. vetana, 3 zimnin beyoma itrechish nisa, begadfayyhu. beshaata deitgele alayyhu kedushsha demalka, innun miggarmayyhu sallekin gadpayyhu, ufarsin lon, vechappeyayn al kapporta. levatar kemitin gadfayyhu, veneechazin begadfayyhu (sefer acher vaneachezayn begufayyhu) kema deat amer (Shemot 25:20) vehayu hakkeruvim porse chenafayim lemala, porse vela peruse. sochchim vela sechuchim. da beat (sefer acher bezot) havo kayyme vechaddan bishchinta.

Amar ribbi abba, ma baa hacha, ki beanan erae al hakkapporet. uchetiv bezot yavo aharon, veha kahana la chame lishchinta beshaata kad hava al. ella anana hava nachit, vechad hava nachit mata al hay kapporet, umitarin gadpayyhu dichruvin, veakshe lehu veamre shirata.

Uma shirata amre (Tehillim 96:4) ki gadol Adonai umehullal meod nora hu al kol elohim. hay kad salke gadpayyhu. beshaata defarsin lehu amre, (Tehillim 96:5) ki kol elohe haammim elilim vaAdonai shamayim asa. kad chafyayn al kapporta, amre, (Tehillim 98:9) lifne Adonai ki va lishpot et haaretz yishpot tevel betzedek veammim bemesharim.

Vekalhon hava shama kahana bemakdesha, keden shavvi ketoret beatreh, veitkevavn bema deitkavvavn, begin deyitberach kolla (vakelahevan). vegadpe keruveyay, sallekin venachtin, vezamre shirata, mechappeyayn lechapporta vesalke lehu. hada hu dichtiv sochchim. sochchim dayyka vmna lan dekalehon ishtema, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:24) vaeshma et kol vegomer.
Amar ribbi yose, veammim bemesharim. mahu bemesharim. kema deat amer, mesharim ahevucha, leachlela teren keruvin, dechar venukeba, mesharim vadday. veal da, veammim bemesharim.

Uchetiv, (Bamidbar 7:89) veyyishma et hakkol middabber elav mibben shene hakkeruvim vaydabber elav. ribbi yitzchak amar, mikkan olifna divchol atar dela ishtechach dechar venukeba, lav keday lemecheme appe shechinta. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 140:14) yeshvu yesharim et panecha, vetanenan, ketiv, (Devarim 32:4) tzaddik veyashar hu, dechar venukeba, uf hacha keruvim dechar venukeba. vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 99:4) atta konanta mesharim. veammim bemesharim. uvegine kach, (Shemot 25:20) ufenehem ish el achiv, veha okimna.
1151: Tanya amar ribbi yose, zimna chada, hava tzericha almma lemitra, atu lekameh (sefer acher azlu legabbeh) derabbi shimon, ribbi yesa veribbi chizkiyya ushear chavrayyay. ashkechuhu dehava azil lemecheme, leribbi pinchas ben yair, hu veribbi elazar bereh. kevan dechama lon, patach veamar, (Tehillim 133:1) shir hammaalot hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad. may shevet achim gam yachad.

Kema deat amer, ufenehem ish el achiv, beshaata dahavo chad bechad mashgichin anpin beanpin, ketiv, ma tov uma naim. vechad mehadder dechura anpoy min nukeba, vavy lealma. keden ketiv, (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat. belo mishpat vadday, uchetiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha, dela azil da bela da, vechad mishpat, mitrachek mitzedek, vavy lealma. (keden ketiv, 2 veyesh nispe belo mishpat).

Vehasheta chamena, deattun atitun, al didchura la sharya benukeba, amar, i leda atitun gabbay tivu. dehay yoma istakkalna, deyithadar kolla lemishre anpin beanpin. vei leorayyta atitun, sharu gabbay. amru leh, lecholla, ka atena legabbe demor, yishtemit chad minan, levassera laachana, shear chavrayyay, vaanan netiv lekameh demor.

Ad dahavo azle, patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:Adonai) shechora ani venava benot yerushalayim vegomer. amra keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, shechora ani begaluta, venava ani befikkude orayyta, deaf al gav deyisrael begaluta la shavke lon. keohole kedar, deinnun bene ketora (sefer acher ture), deitkadderu anpayyhu tedira, veim kol da kiriot shelomo, kehahu chezo shemaya lemidke, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:2) note shamayim kayria.

Al tiruni sheani shecharchoret. may tama (sefer acher ani shacherachevaret begin sheshzafatni) al tiruni, begin sheani shecharchoret. sheshshezafatni hashshamesh, dela istakkal bi shimsha, leanhara li kedka yeot. yisrael ma innun amrin. bene immi nicharu bi. man innun bene immi, illen ravrevin memanan terisin al shear ammin.

Davar acher, bene immi mammash. kema deat amer, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz vegomer. vechad hishlich mishshamayim eretz, samuni notera et hakkeramim. may tama. decharmi shelli lo natarti. vetanenan, bene immi vadday istekamu alay, kelomar, kad itade eretz, mishshamayim, kema deokimna, dichtiv, (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok.

Vehacha ittemar vadday, hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad. uvehu okimna (nusach acher vehacha okimna), gam yachad. kema deat amer (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam, shevet achim bichlal, kevan dichtiv, gam, leachlela kol innun dilella, dechol shuletanuta behahu atar ishtechach.

Davar acher. hinne ma tov uma naim vegomer. illen innun chavrayyay, beshaata deinnun yatvin kachada, vela mitparshan da min da. bekadmita itchazun guvere maggiche kerava, devau lekatla da leda. levatar, ithadaru birchimuta deachva. kudesha berich hu mahu omer, hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad. gam, leachlela immehon shechinta. velo od, ella kudesha berich hu atzit lemillulayyhu, venicha leh vechadde behu. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav vegomer.

Veattun chavrayyay dehacha, kema dahaviton bachavivuta birchimuta, mikkadmat dena, hachi name, mikkan ulehala la titparshun da min da, ad dekudesha berich hu yachde immechon, veyikre alayychu shelam. veyishtekach beginechon shelama bealma. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom bach.

Azlu. ad dahavo azle, matu leve ribbi pinchas ben yair. nafak ribbi pinchas, uneshakeh. amar, zachena lenashsheka shechinta. zakkaa chulaki atkin lehu tikle dearse, kafture dekilta. amar ribbi shimon, orayyta la bae hachi, abar lehon, veyativu. amar ribbi pinchas, ad la nechul, nishma mimmareh deorayyta milla. deha rabbi shimon kol milloy beitgalyay innun, ihu gavra dela dachil meella umitatta, lememar lon, la dachil meella, deha kudesha berich hu istakkam
1152: Beh, la dachil mittatta, kearye dela dachil mibbene ana. amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar beri, elazar kum bekiyyumach, veema milla chadta, legabbe deribbi pinchas ushear chavrayyay.

Kam ribbi elazar patach veamar, vaydabber Adonai el moshe achare mot shene bene aharon vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, deitchaze deyattira ihu. deha ketiv batreh, vayomer Adonai el moshe dabber el aharon achicha. mikkan sheruta defarsheta, hay kera dilella, may hu, dichtiv, vaydabber Adonai el moshe. may hu deamar leh, ulevatar vayomer Adonai el moshe.

Ella beshaata dekudesha berich hu yahav ketoret busemin leaharon, baa, dela yishtamesh beh bechayyyoy bar nash ochora. may tama. begin deaharon asge shelama bealma. amar leh kudesha berich hu, at bae leasgaa shelama bealma, al yedach yisge shelama leella, ha ketoret busemin, yehe masur beyadcha mikkan ulehala, uvechayyecha la yishtamesh beh bar nash ochora. nadav vaavihu akdimu bechayye deavuhon, leakreva ma dela itmesar lehu. umilla da, garim lehon detau beh.

Vetana, moshe hava mehareher, man garam lon tauta da, vahava atziv. ma ketiv, vaydabber Adonai el moshe achare mot shene bene aharon. uma amar leh, bekarvatam lifne Adonai vayamutu. behakerivam la ketiv, ella bekarvatam. amar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, da garma lehu, dedachaku shaata bechayye avuhon, vetau ba, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 10:1) asher lo tzivva otam, otam lo tzivva, aval leaharon tzivva. uma teren bene aharon, al dedachiku shaata bechayye avuhon garmu legarmayyhu kol kach, ana legabbe abba veribbi pinchas ushear chavrayyay, al achat kama vechamma. ata ribbi pinchas neshakkeh uvarcheh.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah vegomer. hine mittato shellishlomo, may mittato. da kurese (nusach acher arsa) yekara demalka, dichtiv beh, (Mishlei 31:11) batach bah lev balah. shellishlomo, malka di shelama kolla dileh hu. shishshim gibborim saviv lah, deitachadan besitraha middina kashya, veikrun, shittin pulese denura, (sefer acher shittin mazeyynay zayvaney kashyayn) dehahu naar, itlebash behu.

Mimineh, shinnana decharba takkifa, missemaleh gomre denura takkifa, demitachada biglifoy (sefer acher bakelaypavey), beshivin elef lahate nura deachla, veinnun shittin mezayyne ziyyune kashyayn, meinnun gevuran takkifin, dehahi gevura illaa dekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv miggibbore yisrael.

Vetana, behay arsa, ma ketiv bah, vattakam beod layla, kad yanka missitra dimina (sefer acher missitra dedina). vattitten teref levetah. may teref, kema deat amer (Micha Adonai:7) vetaraf veen matztzil. hada hu dichtiv kulam achuze cherev melummede milchama, zeminin bechol atar lemebad dina, veikrun mare divava vilala.

Ish charbo al yerecho. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 45:4) chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor. mippachad ballelot. ha ukemuha, mippachdah degehinnam vechulei aval mippachad ballelot, kelomar, kol da maen atar natlin, mippachad, mehahu atar deikre pachad, kema deat amer (Bereshit 31:53) ufachad yitzchak haya li. vayishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak. ballelot, bezimnin deinnun mitpakdin lemebad dina.

Vetana, ketiv (Mishlei 31:16) zamma sade vattikkachehu. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 40:20) vechol chayyat hassade yesachaku sham. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 104:25) ze hayyam gadol urechav yadayim vegomer sham oniyyot yehallechun vegomer kema deat amer. (Mishlei 31:14) hayta kooniyyot socher mimmerchak tavi lachmah. mimmerchak vadday. meresha democha, umeella deresha, tavi lachmah. al yeda detzaddik, kad mizdavvevgan kechad, keden chedu becholla. hada hu dichtiv, livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo.
Tana, elef vachamesh mea, mare terisin, mare deshuletanuta, itachadan mehay sitra, deinnun gibbarin. bidoy dehahu deikre naar, arba maftechin ravrevan. tanninayay azlin techot sefina, dehay
1153: Yamma rabba, learba zavyayn. da azil lesitra da, veda azil lesitra da. vechen kullehu. arba chezu deanpin itchazyayn behu, vechad itkelilan bechad, ketiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam, penehem decholla.

Appe ravreve, veappe zutere, kelilan kechad leella, tere sallekin veshatin, uteren magrofin bidayyhu. elef turin sallekin vealin (sefer acher illen temirin alin vesallekin) bechol yoma, mishshakyu dehahu yamma, levatar, itakaru minnah, vesallekin leyamma ochora.

Let chushebana leinnun deitachadan besaraha, teren benin yankin kol yoma, deikrun mealle ara. veda hu raza desifra ditzniuta, dichtiv, (Yehoshua 2:1) vayyishlach yehoshua bin nun min hashittim shenayim anashim meraggelim cheres lemor. veillen, yankin mittechot sitre evraha, teren banot bitchot raglaha, (sefer acher veillen ynekan missitra daabarehaa, teren benat batechavetahea) veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 6:2) vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam. veillen mitachadan betarpe (sefer acher batevaperay) dehahi arsa, veda hu detanenan, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 3:16) az tavona shetayim nashim zonot el hammelech. az tavona, vela mikkadmat dena, uvezimna deyisrael letatta, ahadrun kedal mibbatar kudesha berich hu, may ketiv, (Yeshayahu 3:12) ammi nogsav meolel venashim mashlu vo. vadday.
Bida semala, shivin anfin, demgaddelin ben nune yamma, kullehu sumake kevavrda. veella minnehon, anpa chad sumaka yattir, da salik venachit. vechullehu itchafyyayn besaraha.

Mare delishana bisha. kad nachit chivya. itavid mekappetz al turin, medalga al tinare. ad deyishkach tarpa, deachid betufere veyechul. keden shachich, veitchazar lishaneh letav. zakkain innun yisrael, dimzammenin leh tarfeh. ahadar leatreh (sefer acher labetareyh), ayyil benukeba dithoma rabba.

Kad (sefer acher salik sallekin) sallekin mare deromchin vesayyfin, delet lon chushebana, sucharanayyhu deinnun shittin illain, desucharaneh dehay arsa, elef alfin, veribbo ribbevavn, kayymin bechol sitra dehay arsa leella. uminneh atteznan, kullehu mikkameh (sefer acher uminneh ittezanu, leh falchin kullehu kammeh) yekumun.
Mittechot kullehu, nafkin kama elef veribbevan, delet lon chushebana, venachtin veshatin bealma, ad detake mare shofara, umitkanneshe. vehane bezuhama detufere achidan.

Da arsa kalil lon, da arsa, raglohi achidan bearba sitre alma, kolla alin bichlala, deishtechach leella, veishtechach letatta, bashamayim mimmaal, veal haaretz mittachat, veal da ketiv hinne. may hinne. begin dizmina lecholla leella vetatta. ureshuma hay arsa mikkolla, adonay itkere, ribbona decholla, reshima ben chayyaylaha.

Begin kach, kahana bae lechavvevna mille dilella, leyachada shema kaddisha meatar devaa leyachada, veal da tanenan, ketiv, bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh, behay bae lekarva kedushsha leatreh, mehay atar, bae bar nash ledachala mikkamme kudesha berich hu. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 32:29) lu chachmu yaskilu zot miyyad yavinu leacharitam. kelomar, i yistakkelun bene nasa beonsha, hech achidat zot ben chayyaylaha, vehech itmanu kammah kol innun bene chayyaylin, vaachidan befulechana leitpara min chayyayvayya, miyyad yavinu leacharitam, veyistamrun ovadehon, vela yechuvun kame malka kaddisha.

Tu amar rabbi shimon, kol bar nash dezache lemelaf orayyta, venatir lah lehay zot. hay zot netirat leh, vegazar immeh kayyeyma al kayyeyma dileh, dela yitade minneh, umin benohi umin bene benohi lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 59:21) vaani zot beriti otam vegomer. yatvu lemechal. ad deachlu, amar rabbi shimon lechavrayyay, kol chad vechad lema milla chadta deorayyta. al patora, lekameh doribbi pinchas.

Patach ribbi chizkiyya veamar, (Yeshayahu 50:4) Adonai elohim natan li leshon limudim ladaat laut et yaef davar vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu mikkol shear amin, ukeraan, kodesh. dichtiv, (yirmeya 2) kodesh yisrael laAdonai. veyahiv
1154: Lehu chulak, leitachada bishma kaddisha. uvemma achidu yisrael bishma kaddisha. begin dezachu beorayyta, dechol man dezache beorayyta zache beh bekudesha berich hu.

(Nusach acher bakkodesh) (297 amud alef) vetanenan kameh demar, may kodesh. shelemuta decholla deikre chachma illaa, umehay atar (nagid meshach rabbot kaddisha bishvilin yedian, laatar deikre bina illaa), umetaman nafkin mebuin unechalin lechol evar, ad dematu lehay zot. (umehay atar ittear rucha kaddisha) vehay zot kad mitbarcha, ikre kodesh, veikre chachma, ukeran leh (nusach acher vehay zot kad itbarcha meatar illaa da deikre kodesh veikre chachma karan leh) ruach hakkodesh. kelomar, ruach, mehahu kodesh dilella. vechad nafkin umitarin minne raze orayyta, keden itkere lashon hakkodesh.

Uveshaata denagid hahu revut kaddisha, leinnun tere kayymin, deikrun limmude Adonai, veikrun tzevaot, itkenash tamman, vechad nafik mittamman, behahu darga deikre yesod, lehahu chachma zeera, keden itkere leshon limudim. venafik leitteara leinnun kaddishe elyonim. keden ketiv, Adonai elohim natan li leshon limudim. velamma. ladaat laut et yaef davar. vekudesha berich hu yahiv hay levutzina kaddisha, rabbi shimon. veod desalik leh leella leella, begin kach kol milloy beitgalyay ittemaru, vela itkasyayn. aleh ketiv, (Bamidbar 12:8) pe el pe adabber bo umare velo vechidot.

Patach ribbi yesa veamar, (Melachim 1 Adonai:26) vaAdonai natan chachma lishlomo kaasher dibber lo vayhi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo vegomer. vaAdonai natan chachma lishlomo, da hu detanenan, beyome dishlomo malka, kayyeyma sihara beashlemuta, kaasher dibber lo, kema deittemar leh, (divrei hayamim 2 1:12) hachachma vehammadda natun lacha.

Vayhi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo. vechi ma ben hay lehay. ella hachi tanenan, vaAdonai natan chachma lishlomo. vehay chachma bemay okim lah. amar ribbi yose, okim lah behay, bekadmita, dishlomo avad denachit lechiram mehahu darga, dehava amar, (Yechezkel 28:2) moshav elohim yashavti vegomer, detanya, chiram melech tzor aved garmeh eloah. batar dishlomo ata, avad leh bechachmateh, denachit mehahu eta, veode leh lishlomo. uvegin kach, (Melachim 1 Adonai:26) vayhi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo.

Vetanenan, amar ribbi yitzchak amar ribbi yehuda, deshadar leh, chad shida, venachit leyad shiva madorin degehinnam vesalkeh, veshadar leh pitkin bechol yoma veyoma bideh, ad deahadar, veode leh lishlomo. vetanenan. (vaychi 223, 225) shelomo yarit lah lesihara, bechol sitroy. begin kach, becholla shallit bechachmateh. verabbi shimon ben yochay, shallit bechachmateh al kol bene alma, kol innun desallekin bedargoy, la sallekin ella leashlema immeh. (sefer acher i lo shalmin immeh)

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:14) yonati bechagvi hassela beseter hammadrega vegomer. yonati, da keneset yisrael, ma yona la shavkat ben zugah lealmin, kach keneset yisrael la shavkat lekudesha berich hu lealmin. bechagvi hassela, illen talmide chachamim, dela mishtakkeche benayycha bealma den. beseter hammadrega, illen talmide chachamim, hatztzenuin, divhon chasidin dachale kudesha berich hu, dishchinta la ade minayyhu lealmin. keden, kudesha berich hu mitteva beginayyhu likkeneset yisrael, veamar, hareini et marayich hashemiini et kolech ki kolech arev, delet kala mishtema leella, ella kala deinnun demitasseke beorayyta.

Vetana, kol innun demitasseke beorayyta, belelya, diyyukenehon itchakkak leella kame kudesha berich hu, vekudesha berich hu mishtasha behu kuleh yoma, umistekal behu. vehahu kala, (dehacha) salik uvaka kol innun rekiin, ad desalik kame kudesha berich hu. keden ketiv, ki kolech arev umarech nav. vehasheta kudesha berich hu chakak diyyukena derabbi shimon leella vekaleh leella leella salleka, umitattera bechitra kaddisha, ad dekudesha berich hu mitattar beh bechullehu almin. umishtebach beh. aleh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Patach ribbi chiyyay veamar, (Kohelet 3:15) ma shehaya kevar hu (nikra shemo 33) vaasher lihyot vegomer. ma shehaya chevar, hayeynu detanenan, ad la bara kudesha berich hu hay alma, hava bare almin vechariv lon, ad
1155: Dekudesha berich hu salik biruteh, lemivre hay alma, veamlich beorayyta. keden ittakkan hu betikkunoy, veitattar beitroy, uvara hay alma. vechol may deishtechach behay alma, ha hava kammeh, (veha salik mikkammeh) veittakkan kammeh.

Vetana, kol innun dabbare alma, deishtechachu bechol dara vedara, ad la yetun lealma, ha havo kayyme kammeh bediyyukenehon. (vehachi tana) afillu kol innun nishmatin divne nasha, ad la yechotun lealma, kullehu gelifin kameh birkia, behahu diyyukena mammash, deinnun behay alma. vechol ma deolfin behay alma, kolla yadu ad la yetun lealma. vetanena, hay beinnun zakkae keshot.

Vechol innun dela mishtakkechin zakkain behay alma, afillu tamman, mitrachakin mikkamme kudesha berich hu, vealin benukeba dithoma rabba, vedachakin shaata, venachtin lealma. vehahi nishmeta dilhon, ha olifna, kema deinnun keshe kedal behay alma, kach havo ad la yetun lealma. vehahu chulaka kaddisha deyahav lon raman leh, veazlin veshatin veastaavun, behahu nukeba dithoma rabba, venatle chulakehon mittamman, vedachakin shaata venachte lealma. i zache levatar, vetav betiyyuveta kame mareh, hu natil hahu chulaka dileh mammash, hada hu dichtiv, ma shehaya kevar (nikra shemo) hu vaasher lihyot vegomer kevar haya.

Ta chaze bene aharon la ishtechachu beyisrael kevavtayyhu, bar moshe veaharon, veinnun ikrun (Shemot 24:9) atzile bene yisrael. veal detau kame malka kaddisha, mitu. vechi kudesha berich hu baa leovada lon, veha tanenan beraza dematnitin, dekudesha berich hu aved chesed becholla, vaafillu berashie alma la bae leovada lon. vehane zakkae keshot salleka datach deinnun itavidu mealma, zechuta dilhon an hu. zechuta deavuhon an hu. zechuta demoshe hachi name. veinnun hech itavidu.

Ella hachi olifna mibbutzina kaddisha, dekudesha berich hu chas al yekara dilhon, veittokad garmehon lego, venishmatehon la itavidu, veha okimna. veta chaze ad la mitu bene aharon ketiv, (Shemot 6:25) veelazar ben aharon lakach lo vegomer, ikre shemeh pinchas, dehava zammin leittakna akima, hada hu dichtiv vaasher lihyot kevar haya.

Vetana, kullehu zakkae keshot, ad la yetun lealma, kullehu ittekanu leella, veikrun bishmahan. verabbi shimon ben yochay, min yoma devara kudesha berich hu alma, hava izdeman kame kudesha berich hu, veishtechach immeh. vekudesha berich hu kare leh bishmeh, zakkaa chulakeh leella vetatta, aleh ketiv (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha, avicha: da kudesha berich hu. veimmecha: da keneset yisrael.

Patach ribbi abba veamar (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, beshaata dekudesha berich hu ishtechach vezammin betura desinay, lemehav orayyta leyisrael, nirdi natan recho, yisrael yahavu useliku recha tav, dekaim veagin alayyhu ledare darin. veamru, (Shemot 24:7) kol asher dibber Adonai naase venishma. davar acher ad shehammelech bimsibbo, beod desalik moshe lekabbela orayyta mekudesha berich hu, veitchakak bitre luche avanin, yisrael shavku hahu recha tava dehava mitatter alayyhu, veamru laegel, elle elohecha yisrael.

Hasheta hay kera beraza dechachmeta hu, ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, hay nahara itpeshat besitroy, beshaata demizdevvavg immeh beziuuga shelim, kade hay eden (ziuuga) behahu nativ, dela ityeyda leella vetatta, kema deat amer (Iyov 28:7) nativ lo yedao ayit. veishtechachu biruta (Shemot 77, 55, 64 amud bet) dela mitparshan tedira chad mechad. keden nafkin mabbuin unechalin, umeatterin leven kaddisha, bechol innun kitrin, keden (Shemot 24 amud alef) ketiv (Shir HaShirim 3:11) baatara sheittera lo immo. uvehahi shaata yarit hahu ben achasanta daavoy veimmeh, keden hu ishtaasha, behahu innuga vetafnuka.
Vetana, beshaata demalka illaa betafnuke malchin, yativ beitroy, keden ketiv ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. da yesod deappik birchan leizdavvevga malka kaddisha
1156: Bematronita. (beha darga) ucheden ityayhavun birchan bechullehu almin, (venafkin) umitbarchan illain vetattain. vehasheta ha butzina kaddisha mitattar beitroy dehay darga, vehu vechavrayyay seliku tushebchan mittatta leella, vehi mitattera beinnun tushebchan. hasheta it leappaka birchan lechullehu chavrayyay meella letatta, behay darga kaddisha, veribbi elazar (sefer acher derabbi elazar) bereh lema meinnun millin mealleyayn deolif meavoy.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Bereshit 29:2) vayyar vehinne veer bassade vegomer. veneesafu shamma chol haadarim vegomer. hane kerae it leistakkela behu, uveraza dechachmeta innun, deolifna meabba, vehachi olifna, vayyar vehinne veer bassade, man beer. da hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim karuha nedive haam. vehine sham shelosha edre tzon rovtzim aleha, illen innun netzach hod yesod, deillen innun reviin alah, vekayymin alah, umeillen itmalleya birchan hahi beer.

Ki min habbeer hahi yashku haadarim, deha min hay beer ittezanu illain vetattain (nusach acher almin tattain), umitbarchan kullehu kachada. vehaeven gedola al pi habbeer, da hu dina kashya, dekayyeyma alah missitra ochora leyanka lah (nusach acher minna). veneesafu shamma chol haadarim, illen innun shit kitre malka, demitkanshe kullehu, venagde birchan meresha demalka, umerikan bah. vechad itchabberan kullehu kachada learka bah, ketiv vegallu et haeven meal pi habbeer, menaddedin (sefer acher magenaderayn) lehahu dina kashya, umeabberan leh minnah.

Vehishku et hatztzon, merikin birchan mehahi beer, leillain vetattain levatar veheshivu et haeven al pi habbeer limkomah. tav hahu dina leatreh, begin deitzterich leh levashma alma, uletakkena alma. vehasheta ha kudesha berich hu arik alayychu birchan, mimmabbua denachala, uminnayychu kol bene dara mitbarchin. zakkaa chulakechon bealma den, uvealma deate alayychu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shalom banayich.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 149:5) yalezu chasidim vechavod yerannenu al mishkevotam vegomer, tana 15 mechilan, itkeshar kishra dimhemnuta, leishtakkecha birchan lecholla. vechol mehemnuta dekudesha berich hu bitlata astimu. veal hay, 15 mechilan, orayyta mitattera, kema deokimna mikal vachomer umiggezera shava vechulei, vechamma zimnin okimna hay. ushema kaddisha behay mitattera.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata devaa yaakov, deyitbarchun benoy bishma (sefer acher bekishra) dimhemnuta. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 49:28) kol elle shivte yisrael shenem asar vezot, ha telesar, deishtattef immehon shechinta, veitkeyaymu birchan. vehayeynu dichtiv, ish asher kevirchato berach otam. may kevirchato. behahu dugema dilella, kevirchato dechol mechila umechila.

Vetana, kol innun mechilin sallekin, umitatterin venayychin beresha chada, vetamman mitattera resha demalka, hahu deikre bedarga illaa dachasidut. vachasidim, yartin chol hahu chavod dilella, dichtiv yalezu chasidim vechavod, behay alma. yerannenu al mishkevotam bealma deate. rommot el bigronam, deyadin lekashshera kishra dimhemnuta kedka yeot, ucheden cherev pifiyyot beyadam. man cherev pifiyyot. da hu cherev laAdonai, charba dekudesha berich hu. pifiyyot: lehita bitren dinin. velamma. laasot nekama baggoyim vegomer.

Veha ribbi pinchas ben yair, kitra dechesed, resha illaa. begin kach kavod dilella yarit, vehu kashir kishra illaa, kishra kaddisha, kishra dimhemnuta. zakkaa chulakeh bealma den uvealma deate. al hay patora ittemar, (Yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai. kam ribbi pinchas, venashik leh, uvarich leh, venashik leribbi elazar, ulechullehu chavrayyay, uvarich lon, natal kassa uvarich.
Patach veamar, (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray vegomer, yatvu (sefer acher chidu) tamman, kol hahu yoma, vahavu chavrayya kullehu chaddan
1157: Bemille deorayyta, vechedvavta derabbi shimon hava sagge. natal ribbi pinchas leribbi elazar, vela shavkeh kol hahu yoma vechol lelya, vahava chadde immeh, kara aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, kol chedvavta veinnuga yattira da dechulaki hu, (al da deamme hu al da ketiv 1 ashre haam shekkacha lo vegomer) zeminin behahu alma leachreza alay, zakkaa chulakach ribbi pinchas, deant zachit lechol hay, (divrei hayamim 1 12:19) shalom lecha veshalom leozrecha ki azarcha elohecha. ashkimu lemezal, kam ribbi pinchas veachid beh beribbi elazar, vela shavkeh lemehach. ozif ribbi pinchas lerabbi shimon uvarcheh, ulechullehu chavrayyay. ad dahavu azle amar lehu ribbi shimon lechavrayyay, (Tehillim 119:126) et laasot laAdonai.

Ata ribbi abba veshail, ketiv venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot vegomer. hane advin lamma. veaharon lamma leh lemehav advin. ufarsheta da lamma. veha olifna kamme demar sidra deyoma, vehay beena leminda.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Bereshit 42:24) vayikkach meittam et shimon vayyeesor oto leenehem. vechi ma chama yosef lemesav leshimon immeh yattir meachohi. ella, amar yosef, vechol atar shimon (velevi) petichuta dedina ihu (inun), vehahi shaata daazilna meabba legabbayyhu deechay, shimon patach bekadmita bedina, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 37:19-20) vayyomru ish el achiv hinne baal hachalomot hallaze ba veatta lechu vegomer. levatar vishchem, (Bereshit 34:25) vayyikchu shene bene yaakov shimon velevi, kullehu bedina havo. tav lemesav da, vela yittear ketatuta bechullehu shevatin.

Vetanenan, may ka chama shimon leizdavvevga belevi yattir mikkolla. veha reuven hava achuha vesamich leh, ella shimon chama veyada delevi missitra dedina ka ate, veshimon missitra dedina kashya yattir itachad. amar nitarav chad bechad vaanan necheriv alma. ma aved kudesha berich hu, natal leh lechulakeh lelevi, amar mikkan ulehala shimon letiv bekufetira bahaddeh bilchodoy.

Tana besitra deima, teren gardine tehirin (sefer acher terisin) itachadan bida semala, veha okimna deinnun mealle ara vechol yoma veyoma, vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Yehoshua 2:1) shenayim anashim meraggelim.

Vetana, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael yattir mikkol ammin ovde avoda zara dekudesha berich hu bae ledakkea lehu, ulerachama alayyhu, deinnun chulakeh veadveh, hada hu dichtiv (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo vegomer, uchetiv (Devarim 32) yarkivehu al bomote aretz. al bomote aretz dayyka. deha innun itachadan leella leella. veal da kudesha berich hu rechimuta dileh itdevak behu, hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai, uchetiv (Devarim 7:8) ki meahavat Adonai etchem vegomer, umiggo rechimuta yattira derachim lehu, yahav lon yoma chad beshatta ledacha lehu, ulezakkaa lehu mikkol chovehon, dichtiv, (Vayikra 16) ki vayyom hazze vegomer. begin dihon zakkain bealma den, uvealma deate, vela yishtekach behu chova. veal da beyoma da, mitatterin yisrael, veshaltin al kullehu gardinin, veal kullehu tehirin.

Tana (Vayikra 16:8) venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot. venatan aharon, begin deate missitra dechesed. al shene hasseirim, al dayyka, begin detitbasam matronita. goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazel veha teren seirin innun, amay chad laAdonai. ella amar kudesha berich hu, yetiv hay gabbay, vechad yezil veyishot bealma, deilmale tarvayyhu mizdavvevgan, la yachil alma lemisbal.

Nafak hay, azil veshat bealma, veashkach lehu leyisrael, bechamma pulechanin, bechamma dargin, bechamma nimusin tavan, la yachil lehu, kullehu shelama benayyhu, la yachil lemeal behu bedaltora. (azal veshat bealma, veashkach leyisrael kehay gavvna) (nusach acher yisrael letatta uf hachi kehay gavvna) hay seira shalchin leh bematula dechol chovayyhu deyisrael.
Tana, kama chavile terikin mizdavvevgan (nusach acher mizdammenan), deinnun techot yedeh, umemanan lealla ara, al kol innun
1158: Deavrin al pitgame orayyta. vehahu yoma, la shechiach dalttora (sefer acher pitra) lemallela behu beyisrael. kad mata hay seira legabbe tura, kama chedu al chedu mitvassemin kullehu beh. vehahu gardina denafik, ahdar veamar tushebachta deyisrael, kategora itavid sanegora.

Veta chaze, lav da bilchodoy hu, ella bechol atar devayayn yisrael leitdakkea mechovayyhu, kudesha berich hu yahiv lon eta lekashshera mare dedina, ulevassema lehu beinnun karbenin veillavavn, dikrevin kame kudesha berich hu, ucheden la yachlin leavasha. vehahu yoma yattir al kolla, kema demvassemin yisrael letatta lecholla, hachi mevassemin lechol innun deit lehu dalttora (sefer acher pitra) vecholla karbena hu ufulechana dekudesha berich hu.

Tana, behahi shaata dichtiv, velakach aharon et shene hasseirim vegomer, mitarin innun behahu yoma leella, uvayayn leshalletaa (nusach acher lashetaah) ulemeppak bealma. kevan dechahana mekarev illen letatta, mitkarvin innun leella. keden advin sallekin bechol sitrin, kahana yahav advin letatta, kahana yahiv advin leella. kema dechad ishtear beh bekudesha berich hu letatta. vechad appekin leh lehahu madbera, hachi name leella, chad ishtear beh bekudesha berich hu, vechad nafik veshat bealma, lehahu madbera illaa, vechad bechad mitkashshar.

Ketiv (Vayikra 16:21) vesamach aharon et shete yadav al rosh hassair hachay vehitvadda alav vegomer. begin kach vesamach aharon et shete yadav, dekudesha berich hu yistekam al yedoy. al rosh hassair hachay, hachay dayyka, leachlela hahu dilella.

(Vayikra 5) vehitvadda alav et kol avonot, kema dichtiv (Vayikra Adonai:Adonai) vehitvadda asher chata aleha. veokimna aleha, deitdakke bar nash veishtear aleha kol hahu chova. uf hachi vehitvadda alav, batar deode kahana beginayyhu deyisrael, alav: kelomar, yishtaarun kullehu alav.

Amar leh ribbi abba, i hachi veha ketiv velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim, amar leh shane hacha, dehatam lasseirim havo kerevin karbena, uvegin kach la ketiv velo yizbechu od et zivchehem seirim, ella lasseirim, dehatam lasseirim havo avde pulechana, veshuletanuta. vehacha venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam, vekarbena la itavid ella lekudesha berich hu. ta chaze, divgine karbena mitbasseman illain vetattain, vedina la sharya veshalta alayyhu deyisrael.
Tana, veshillach beyad ish itti hammidbara. mahu ish itti. ella raza demilla hachi hu

Raya mehemna pikkuda (44) da, lemiflach rabba kahana pulechana dehahu yoma kema deitztzetrich, ulemishlach sair laazazil. raza da kema deat amer, begin leitparsha meamma kaddisha, vela yitba chovehon kame malka. vela yekatreg alayyhu, deha let leh tekifu veshuletanu, (bah) bar kad ittakaf rugeza milleella, uvehahu dorona ithappach levatar appotrofosa alayyhu, veal da itdachyay mikkamme malka. veha okimna, begin deihu ketz kol basar.

Veamma kaddisha yahavin leh kema deitztzetrich leh sair, veraza da (Bereshit 27:11) hen esav achi ish sair. kema deihu bistar dikdushsha dechar venukeba, uf hachi bistar mesaavu dechar venukeba. matla amre, lechalba arme leh garma, yelachech afra deraglach.

Shaalu leven zoma, mahu lesaruse kalva. amar lahem, (Vayikra 22:24) uveartztzechem lo taasu, kol shebbeartztzechem lo taasu. kema deitztzetrich alma lehay, hachi itztzetrich alma lehay. veal da ittemar, (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod da malach hammavt. let levatla leh min alma, alma itztzetrich leh, af al gav dichtiv beh, (Yeshayahu 56:11) vehakkelavim azze nefesh lo yadu sava vegomer, la yitvatlun min alma. kolla itztzetrich tov vara.
Uvegine kach it lan beyoma da lemirme leh garma lechalba, ad deihu garir, yeul man deyeul legabbe hechala demalka, velet man deyimche bidoy. levatar
1159: Bechol ma deitavid, bae bar nash zammin lehahi milla. it bar nash devircheta itkayyaym al yedeh yattir meochora. ta chaze, ma ketiv beh bechahana, (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach, al tikre yevorach, ella yevarech, begin dehu zammin deyitkayyaym birchata al yedeh behay. (sefer acher veshari bircheta beashgachuta dileh).

Veit bar nash dehu zammin leitkayyeyma levavtin al yedeh, uvechol ma deyashgach lete levavtayay umeera uveita kegon bilam, deikre ra ayin, dehava zammin bechol bish, vela hava zammin letav. veaf al gav divrach, birchateh la birchata, vela itkeyyaym. vechad hava layit, kol man delayit itkeyyaym, veafillu beriga chada, veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 24:3) shetum haayin. bechol atar deeneh shalta itlatteyay.

Ta chaze ma ketiv. (Bamidbar 24:1) vayyashet el hammidbar panav, begin deyitar mehahu sitra hahu deshalta tamman, veyete bedaltorya alayyhu deyisrael. ma ketiv behu bechahane, (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach, dehu hava zammin behay, veshari birchata beashgachuta dileh. veal da tanenan, yiste bar nash afillu mimmea archin, vela yira bebar nash deit leh ena bisha.

Uf hacha veshillach beyad ish itti, dehu zammin lehay. verashim lehay, vechahana hava ishtemoda beh, chad ena yatir meochora pureta. sureta deal ena itchappeya besaarin sagiin. mekachala ena, vela mistakkal bemeshar. hay hu bar nash zammin lehay, vechadka chaze leh. veal da ketiv beyad ish itti.

Begush chalava hava bar nash, divchol atar demache bidoy, hava mit, vela havo bene nasa mekarvin bahadeh. besureyya hava bar nash, divchol atar deistakkal afillu letav, kolla ithappach levish. yoma chad hava chad bar nash azil beshuka, vahavu anpoy nehirin. ata hahu bar nash veistakkal beh, veitbaka eneh. begin kach, becholla hava bar nash zammin, lehay ulehay. veal da ketiv tov ayin hu yevorach, al tikre yevorach ella yevarech.

Vetana, hay bar nash dehava azil lemadbera, kad mata beh behahu seira hava salik letura, vedache leh bitren yedoy. vela hava nachit lefalgut tura, ad deitavid shayyfin shayyfin. vehahu bar nash hava amar, kach yimmachu avonot ammecha vegomer. uvegin desalik hahu kategorya veitavid sanegorya deyisrael, keden kudesha berich hu, kol chovayyhu deyisrael, vechol ma dichtiv beinnun pitkin dilella, leadkera chovayyhu divne nasha, natil lon ureme lon kehay gavvna, laatar deitkere metzulot yam. hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) vetashlich bimtzulot yam kol chattotam.

Tana, (Vayikra 16:5) umeet adat bene yisrael yikkach shene seire izzim lechattat, umeet adat, begin diyhe mikkullehu, veyitkapper lechullehu. deha kol chovayyhu divne yisrael hacha talyayn, vechullehu mitkappere beda.

Ma ketiv vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael, uchetiv venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam. kevan deihu chame hay sair. tiuveteh legabbeh, uleishtachllela bahaddeh, vela yada meinnun chovin deka natil sair. tav legabbayyhu deyisrael, chame lon bela chovin, bela peshain, deha kullehu sharan beresha deshair, salik leella, veshabbach lon kame kudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu chame sahaduta dehahu mekatrega, vehoil vetiuveteh lerachama al ammeh, af al gav deihu yada kol ovada, chas aleyhon deyisrael.

Vecholla sharya beda, begin dela yittear raza dedina milleella, veyittekaf hay veyishtetztzun bene alma, deha da missitra dedina kashya ka ate. vei yittear hay, bechove bene enasha ittear. deha let leh attearu lesalleka leella leitteara dina kashya bar bedil chove bene nasha. deha beshaata debar nash avid chova, itkenash hay, vechamma elef sayyan dileh, umitkannefe tamman, venatle leh, vesalke leella rachamana lishezvan. veal kolla yahav kudesha berich hu eta leyisrael leishtezava mikkol sitrin. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav. (ad kan raya mehemana)
